Role Title: Danish Transcription Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Danish Transcription Experts to participate in a customer-driven project focused on developing advanced AI technologies. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for native Danish speakers with strong transcription backgrounds who are interested in contributing to the future of AI.

Scope of Work

  1. Transcribe Danish audio files with a high degree of accuracy and linguistic nuance.
  2. Annotate and label speech data according to detailed project guidelines and standards.
  3. Carefully evaluate and verify the quality of transcriptions to ensure consistency and completeness.
  4. Work with AI workflow tools to process, correct, and enhance audio data sets.
  5. Participate in the review and refinement of annotation schema as project needs evolve.
  6. Provide constructive feedback to improve transcription processes and support continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Native-level proficiency in Danish, with exceptional listening and language skills.
  2. Demonstrated experience transcribing and annotating Danish audio in professional or research settings.
  3. Strong attention to detail in identifying errors, inconsistencies, and nuances in spoken content.
  4. Familiarity with audio data collection protocols and transcription tools or platforms.
  5. Knowledge of AI workflows or prior involvement in data training for machine learning projects (a plus, not required).
  6. Ability to follow complex instructions and adhere to evolving guidelines and standards.
  7. Excellent organizational and communication abilities to support collaborative remote work.

Role Title: Gmail & Google Calendar AI Assistant Evaluator

Role Type: Contractor, Remote

Location: United States only

micro1 is engaging Gmail & Google Calendar AI Assistant Evaluators to collaborate on a customer-driven project enhancing AI assistant quality through real-world task evaluation. In this role, you'll use your everyday experience managing your digital life — email, calendars, bookings, and coordination — to help train and evaluate next-generation AI assistants. Your work will shape how AI models handle the real tasks people delegate every day.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Complete realistic, everyday digital tasks (emailing, scheduling, booking, coordinating) using AI assistant tools under standardized, repeatable conditions.
  2. Give an AI assistant clear instructions for real-world tasks, then carefully review and verify its work for accuracy and completeness.
  3. Apply detailed grading guidelines to evaluate, rank, and annotate assistant responses, providing structured feedback that improves model performance.
  4. Test scenarios involving email threads, calendar invites, online bookings, and multi-person coordination, ensuring coverage of diverse situations and edge cases.
  5. Utilize AI training tools and platforms to record findings and submit evaluation data in alignment with project standards and milestones.
  6. Collaborate with project trainers and contributors to resolve ambiguities, refine guidelines, and ensure evaluation consistency across the team.
  7. Participate in ongoing quality reviews, incorporating feedback to maintain rigorous evaluation standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Are based in the US, have an iPhone with iMessage, and have a Facebook or Instagram account.
  2. Daily, hands-on use of Gmail and Google Calendar to run your own life: sending emails, accepting invites, scheduling, and rearranging plans.
  3. Regular experience coordinating with others over email or text — setting up meetups, following up on threads, or confirming shared plans and payments.
  4. Comfort booking things online independently, such as restaurants, appointments, travel, or deliveries.
  5. Experience using AI tools for real, practical tasks, with comfort giving an AI assistant instructions and checking its work.
  6. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing AI-generated output.
  7. Strong written communication skills for clear reporting and timely updates on progress and challenges.
  8. Demonstrated time management and self-organization for independent, remote project participation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Prior experience with AI evaluation, data labeling, user testing, or similar feedback-driven projects.
  2. Familiarity with prompt writing and a practical understanding of AI assistant behaviors and limitations.
  3. Experience grading or reviewing AI outputs for accuracy, helpfulness, and safety.

raw.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is a fast-growing, AI-native healthcare company. We are seeking an IT Operations Specialist to support our San Francisco office and rapidly scaling workforce. This role provides onsite and remote support across hardware, software, access, collaboration tools, and conference room technology.

You will help build a modern IT operations function designed for an AI-native company. You will use AI ITSM, automation, and agentic workflows to resolve issues, reduce manual work, and improve the employee experience. You will also partner across Abridge to develop scalable processes that support our continued growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Own daily IT support operations and serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee issues.

  • Manage support requests through Serval, including triage, resolution, escalation, documentation, and follow-up.

  • Build agentic support workflows that improve response times, resolution quality, and the employee experience.

  • Design and maintain automations for onboarding, offboarding, access requests, birthright access, and other employee lifecycle events.

  • Manage account access across SaaS applications using secure, scalable, and policy-based processes.

  • Provide expert support for workplace hardware, desktop software, collaboration tools, and conference room technology.

  • Identify recurring issues and replace manual work with reliable, well-documented automation.

  • Maintain clear operating procedures, support documentation, and service performance data.

  • Partner with PeopleOps, Security, Engineering, and business teams to build effective technical solutions.

  • Help define the standards, systems, and automation that will shape the future of IT Operations at Abridge.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in IT operations, service desk, or enterprise end-user support.

  • Experience managing tickets, incidents, access requests, and escalations in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills across SaaS applications, hardware, operating systems, and workplace technology.

  • Experience building or managing IT workflows, integrations, and automations.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical employees.

  • Strong organization and attention to detail while managing multiple priorities.

  • A service-focused approach that combines urgency, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying operational improvements.

  • The ability to work across teams and translate business requirements into scalable IT processes.

  • A strong interest in agentic support, automation, and the continued evolution of enterprise IT.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Serval or another AI ITSM platform eg., Console, Ravenna

  • Experience supporting regulated organizations, including healthcare, finance, or government.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management, role-based access control, and employee lifecycle automation.

  • Experience with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Zoom Rooms.

  • Experience using APIs, workflow tools, or scripts to automate IT operations.

  • Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) systems.

  • Working experience in a both Mac & Windows operating systems

  • Working experience in a fast paced tech startup with a customer first mindset.

The salary range provided is based on transparent pay guidelines and is an estimate for candidates residing in the San Francisco and New York City metro areas. The actual base salary will vary depending on the candidate's location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and other job-related factors. Additionally, this role may include the opportunity to participate in a company stock option plan as part of the total compensation package.

Must be willing to work from our SF office at least 3x per week

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to San Francisco.

We value people who want to learn new things, and we know that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $100K - $115K

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

The Role

As we expand our financing proposition in Hungary, we are looking for a Credit Specialist who can engage eligible merchants, explain financing options clearly, and support them through the journey from first contact to handover and approval.

This is a sales-focused, customer-facing role for someone who is confident on the phone, motivated by commercial targets, and experienced in selling business financing or loan products. You should be comfortable understanding merchant needs, matching them to the right funding solution, and moving opportunities forward with pace and ownership.

What you will do

Contact eligible customers for Teya financing

  • Proactively contact merchants eligible for Teya financing, explain available financing options and key terms, and understand their business needs and funding requirements

Qualify and hand over financing leads

  • Assess customer interest and eligibility, collect and validate the necessary information and documentation, and hand over qualified leads to financing partners in a timely manner

Support clients through the risk and approval process

  • Guide customers through documentation and risk checks, coordinate with internal teams and external partners when needed, and keep merchants informed throughout the application process

Provide excellent customer support

  • Answer financing-related inquiries, manage customer expectations, escalate complex cases, and maintain accurate records in internal systems

Learn, grow, and support the team

  • Develop expertise in financing products and processes, contribute to knowledge sharing and process improvements, and support financing campaigns and other team initiatives

Your story

  • 2+ years of proven experience in a sales role focused on financing, lending, or loan products

  • University degree in Finance, Economics or similar field

  • Confidence in speaking with customers by phone and moving commercial conversations forward

  • A strong sales mindset, with the ability to identify customer needs, build interest, and convert qualified opportunities

  • Ability to explain financial products and key conditions in a clear, simple, and credible way

  • Good judgement when qualifying leads and handling sensitive customer conversations

  • High attention to detail and discipline in keeping systems and documentation up to date

  • Ability to work across internal teams and external partners in a structured and responsive way

  • A proactive, hands-on attitude and willingness to learn fast in a growing environment

  • Excellent communication skills in Hungarian and English

The Perks

  • Szép Card (gross 450.000 HUF yearly)

  • All You Can Move Sport Pass (XL)

  • Private health insurance

  • 3 extra mental health days yearly

  • 5 therapy or coaching session per year

  • Free monthly public transport passes or garage space at the office

  • Office snacks every day

  • Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in the heart of Buda

  • Possibility to work in an international environment with colleagues all around the world

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

The Role:

As a Senior Software Developer, you will design, build, and maintain modern, scalable

cloud-native applications using .NET (C#) and React on Microsoft Azure. Contributing

across the full stack, you will deliver performant backend API services and intuitive front-

end experiences that support product growth and platform stability — on a system that

demands high concurrency, high transaction volumes, and exceptional reliability.

You will work cross-functionally with product, cloud, and engineering teams to deliver high-

performance solutions that improve patient outcomes and modernize how healthcare is

delivered. You bring deep technical expertise, a cloud-native mindset, and an AI-first

approach to every layer of the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

Backend Development

  • Design and build robust, scalable, and maintainable backend services using .NET Core (C#), following clean architecture and SOLID principles.

  • Develop and maintain RESTful and event-driven APIs capable of sustaining high-throughput, concurrent workloads.

  • Develop data access layers using MS SQL Server, with a strong emphasis on query optimization, indexing strategies, connection pooling, and transaction management for high-volume environments.

  • Implement resilience patterns including circuit breakers, retry policies to ensure system stability under load.

Design and deploy cloud-native solutions leveraging core Azure services:

  • Azure App Services — hosting and scaling web APIs and front-end applications.

  • Azure Function Apps — building lightweight, event-driven compute components.

  • Azure Event Grid — designing reactive, decoupled event-driven architectures for distributed systems.

  • Azure Storage Accounts — implementing Blob Storage, Queue Storage, and Table Storage for scalable data and messaging needs.

Frontend Development:

  • Build responsive, performant user interfaces using React 18+ (TypeScript strict mode), following hooks-only, functional component patterns within an Nx monorepo structure.

  • Develop within and contribute to an internal design system built on Mantine, preferring shared component abstractions over raw library usage.

  • Implement scalable data-fetching using React Query and internal API hooks, with clean separation of server state from UI state.

  • Write frontend tests using Jest and React Testing Library, maintaining 90%+ line coverage with mock-first patterns for all API hooks and external dependencies.

  • Collaborate with UX/design to translate wireframes and specifications into responsive UI experiences.

  • Optimize frontend performance for scalability through lazy loading, code splitting, and efficient rendering strategies.

AI-First Engineering:

  • Apply an AI-first mindset to daily development — leveraging AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and AI-assisted testing and observability platforms as foundational instruments to accelerate productivity and elevate code quality.

  • Evaluate and champion the adoption of emerging AI tooling across the engineering team, driving continuous improvement in how the team designs, builds, and validates software.

Quality Engineering:

  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end automated tests as a core part of the development workflow — not an afterthought.

  • Champion a test-first culture, ensuring testability is a primary design consideration in every feature and service.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, maintaining high standards for correctness, performance, security, and long-term maintainability.

Core Skills and Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with product owners, and DevOps engineers to deliver cohesive, reliable solutions

  • Contribute to system design, architecture decisions, and performance optimizations

  • Support software delivery through CI/CD pipelines across QA, Staging, and production environments.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices

  • Participate in code reviews, mentoring, and knowledge sharing across the team

  • Ensure secure, reliable, and compliant systems in a regulated environment (e.g., healthcare or finance if applicable)

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a technology-related field; or equivalent experience with at least ten (10) years of strong technical experience in .NET (C#) and React.

  • Solid understanding of API design, REST principles, authentication/authorization (OAuth2, JWT, etc.)

  • Proficiency with SQL Server and data modeling.

  • A minimum of three (3) years of practical experience in Microsoft Azure.

  • Experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript and full-stack development required.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

  • Experience working in agile/scrum methodology.

  • Detail oriented with the ability to multitask, manage time, and communicate effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently apply a broad range of theories, concepts, principles, and methodologies to product projects involving complex features.

  • Experience with microservice architecture, CQRS, or event-driven design preferred.

  • Exposure to containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes preferred.

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare or finance preferred.

  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., App Insights, OpenTelemetry) preferred.

Core Competencies:

Knowledge & Application:

Complete knowledge and full understanding of area of specialization, principles and practices within a professional discipline. Assesses unusual circumstances and uses sophisticated analytical and problem solving techniques to identify cause. Resolves and assesses a wide range of issues in creative ways and suggests variations in approach. This job is a for fully qualified, experienced professional.

Complexity & Problem Solving:

Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of information requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Devises solutions based on limited information and precedent and adapts existing approaches to resolve issues. Uses evaluation, judgment, and interpretation to select right course of action. Work is done independently and is reviewed at critical points.

Collaboration & Interaction:

Enhances relationships and networks with senior internal/ external partners who are not familiar with the subject matter often requiring persuasion. Adapts style to differing audiences and often advises others on difficult matters.

Working Conditions & Environment:

  • Fully remote role within the United States

  • Periodic travel (approximately 10-15 %) for team meetings, and company events

  • Operates in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, PE-backed SaaS environment

  • Requires cross-functional collaboration across Product, Sales, Customer Success,and Executive Leadership

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent product launches and shifting priorities.

Success in this role requires the ability to balance synchronous collaboration with

thoughtful asynchronous execution in a remote-first environment

Benefits & Perks:

💸Competitive compensation

🌍Remote-first

Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

Flexible work
Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life.

✈ Company-wide offsite
We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together.

🌴Time off that you’re expected to use
Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

💙Comprehensive health coverage
Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.
Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection).

💰Financial wellness
401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

raw.excerpt: About SafeLeaseAt SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change.
raw.description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

Why "Builder"?

The best people on our team start with a business problem, figure out what should exist to solve it, and then build it, often end-to-end. They talk to stakeholders, sketch out solutions, make product and design decisions, write the code, and ship it. They use AI tools not as a novelty but as a core part of how they work. The line between "product thinking" and "engineering" isn't one they spend much time drawing.

We call this role Builder because that's what it actually is. You'll work in small pods with a GM who sets direction, but how you get there and what you build along the way is largely up to you.

If you're looking for a well-defined backlog and a narrow lane, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want the autonomy to solve real problems and the context to understand why they matter, keep reading.

About the Role

To drive our mission forward, this role will:

  • Start with the problem, not the ticket. Understand the business context behind what you're building. Know why it matters to customers, to the business, and to the team.

  • Own outcomes, not just output. Take features from idea to production. That means participating in product and design decisions, not waiting for a spec to land in your lap.

  • Build across the full stack. Write clean, maintainable code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with a focus on reliability, performance, and simplicity.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage AI-powered tools to move faster, explore solutions more broadly, and spend your time on the problems that actually require human judgment.

  • Improve the system, not just your code. Identify opportunities to make the platform better, the team faster, and the product sharper. Bring ideas, not just implementations.

  • Collaborate with high context. Work closely with your pod, leadership, and cross-functional partners. Share what you know, ask what you don't.

About You

You're a problem solver who happens to write code, not the other way around. You care about what gets built as much as how it gets built. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energized by ownership, and sharp enough to develop a working understanding of the business you're building for.

Your experience:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in full-stack software development with a track record of shipping real-world applications

  • Background in CS/EE, a coding bootcamp, or equivalent hands-on experience building production systems

  • Proficiency across Frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript, React), Backend (Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs), and Infrastructure (relational databases, Git, AWS)

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-powered development tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) — not just awareness, but active use in your workflow

  • Ability to think beyond code: you consider the user, the business case, and the tradeoffs, not just the implementation

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset — you ask good questions, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better

  • DevOps experience is a plus — understanding how your code runs in production matters here

  • Excited to work in-person or hybrid from our downtown Austin office

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

Job Opening: QA Supervisor

Location: South Africa (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: Monday to Friday (9 AM - 5 PM EST)

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop a theologically grounded, highly visual book exploring sacred art—past or present—that helps readers engage both its beauty and its theological depth. This project should integrate compelling visuals with thoughtful, accessible commentary that invites reflection, worship, and deeper understanding. It could take the form of a trade book, coffee table book, or something else. The strongest proposals will clearly define the reader and demonstrate how the visual and written elements will work together to explore the beauty and meaning of sacred art.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book
  • Please ensure a list of the pieces of art that you would like to include is part of the detailed outline

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

Influencer Coordinator
Position Location: Remote
Reports to: Senior Influencer Manager, Creator + Community

About SkinnyDipped

Located in Seattle, SkinnyDipped was founded by a mom, her daughter, and two best friends after realizing that nothing is more important than time spent with the ones you love. Starting out of their kitchen, the four women created SkinnyDipped: thinly dipped chocolate almonds that are exceptionally good-for-you and ridiculously delicious. We are a women-led company driven by the belief that healthy snacking should make both you and your body happy.

The Opportunity

In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience across influencer marketing, including

creator outreach and gifting, UGC, event gifting, college activations, and campaign

management. You’ll work closely with the Influencer Marketing Lead to support creator

campaigns, develop briefs, and identify opportunities that align with SkinnyDipped’s

brand and audience. You’ll use platforms like Tribe to discover and vet creators,

manage creator campaigns, track performance, and pull reporting and insights. You’ll

use OnBrand to support product seeding and event gifting, and work with Home From

College (H/FC) on smaller scale campaigns, college activations, and brand ambassador

programs. You’ll also gain exposure to paid media and creative strategy, using

performance insights to help shape creator briefs and content. This role is ideal for

someone passionate about social media, digital culture, creators, and the ever-evolving

influencer landscape.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Research & Gifting: Find creators who are a natural fit for the

    • SkinnyDipped brand and consistently reach out to 200+ creators per week for

    gifting opportunities.

  • Gifting Operations: Manage the gifting process end to end, including creator

    • outreach, collecting shipping information, maintaining accurate gifting records,

    coordinating shipments, and tracking deliveries and follow-ups.

  • Creator & Content Tracking: Maintain gifting history, track gifted content and

    • creator engagement, and assist with reporting and follow-up as needed.

  • Event Gifting & Fulfillment: Manage event gifting through OnBrand,

    • thoughtfully evaluating and prioritizing events that align with SkinnyDipped’s

    brand and gifting goals. Work closely with Logical to ensure event orders are

    accrately processed and fulfilled on time.

  • UGC Creator Management: Support UGC creator initiatives by leading

    • communication with pre contracted creators, providing monthly creative briefs,

    coordinating content deliverables, and reviewing and approving content to ensure

    it aligns with SkinnyDipped’s brand standards.

  • Creative & Paid Media Alignment: Participate in paid media calls to understand

    • which creative concepts and content are performing well, and apply those

    learnings when developing creator briefs. Work closely with the Influencer

    Marketing Lead to develop creative direction, align on creator selection, and

    ensure UGC supports broader influencer and marketing goals.

  • H/FC Campaigns & College Activations: Utilize Home From College (H/FC)

    • for smaller-scale campaigns, college activations, and brand ambassador

    initiatives. Work closely with the Influencer Marketing Lead to develop, execute,

    and manage campaigns from planning through completion.

  • Tribe Management: Own the Tribe platform and stay on top of monthly

    • campaigns, including reviewing & identifying new creators, and managing gifting

    through the platform. Monitor creator and brand activity to stay informed on

    trends and understand how other brands are leveraging creators and gifting.

  • Reporting & Insights: Provide quarterly gifting reports and work closely with the

    • Influencer Marketing Lead to develop quarterly influencer reports, tracking key

    performance metrics and identifying trends and insights. Maintain the ability to

    quickly pull performance reports and insights from Tribe as needed, including

    monthly creator performance, campaign results, and other influencer activity to

    support decision-making.

What You Bring to the Table

    Skills & Strengths

  • Strong knowledge of influencer marketing, creator communities, and social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.)
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple
  • projects
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and creative mindset
  • Passion for better for you snacks

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience working with or managing creators/influencers
  • Familiarity with influencer tools (e.g., CreatorIQ, Grin, etc.)
  • Personal interest in pop culture, internet trends, and social storytelling

    • A Few More Things We Value

    • You’re hungry to learn and love being a team player.
    • You like pitching in wherever needed and you’re not scared of grunt work.
    • You’re passionate about snacks, storytelling, and growing a brand.
    • You bring a great attitude and energy to the team.

Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary
    • Annual performance bonus
    • Equity opportunity
    • Excellent medical/dental/vision benefits
    • 401(k)
    • 3 weeks paid vacation + 14 paid holidays
    • Paid parental leave
    • Paid time off to volunteer
    • Additional perks like wellness & tech stipends
    • Fun, entrepreneurial culture

A Bit More About Us

We’re a female-founded success story. This alone—regardless of the industry—requires true grit, mettle, and perseverance. We operate with an ethos that any idea is plausible until proven otherwise. A bold flavor combo with a totally new production method? Let’s try it. A major change to improve quality, even if it’s hard? We’ll make it happen. We lead with conviction, not hesitation. The world can be intimidating, but we stay curious, driven, and brave.

Our Mission

We craft ethical food that makes you and your body happy. We believe everyone deserves to eat the kind of nutritious, clean, delicious food we’re fortunate enough to share with our own families and friends. We work to raise up and support women and the children they care for in both our local communities and around the globe because no child should go without food or an education.

About Us

At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

And now we are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join us as part of our team.

About the role

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others.

As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a group of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation.

As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Technology & Engineering division, you will be responsible for managing and growing several self-organized engineering teams, driving delivery excellence, and representing development direction at a strategic level. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment, performance, and team success.

Tech Stack: Java, Python, TS/JS/React, GCP, Vertex AI, AWS, Bedrock etc

Team setup: 2-5 teams

Work Environment: ​​flexible

As a qualified expert You will

  • Manage and grow multiple engineering teams and their leaders within a business unit or product area.
  • Cultivate technical excellence and a culture of continuous learning across teams.
  • Participate in and supervise discussions on key technical decisions, delivery expectations, and people allocation.
  • Represent the development direction at the strategic (VP) level, including plans, results, metrics, and capabilities.
  • Drive AI tool adoption to improve team efficiency and delivery speed.
  • Encourage learning through AI-assisted development and automation.
  • Coach teams on best practices for software delivery, estimation, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure clear goals, priorities, and resource allocation while maintaining technical excellence and innovation.
  • Foster a culture of trust, transparency, collaboration, and constructive feedback.
  • Maintain high morale and motivation, especially during challenging circumstances.
  • Balance business, team, and individual needs through effective communication and decision-making.
  • Recognize team achievements and help teams learn from challenges or failures.
  • Manage staffing, including hiring new team members aligned with company values and culture.
  • Monitor and assess team performance, conduct performance reviews, and ensure fair compensation processes.
  • Support the adoption of DevOps practices and modern engineering methodologies.

We’re looking for you if you have

  • Mature understanding of the manager’s role, with a strong product- and results-oriented mindset, demonstrating strong ownership and focus on delivering outcomes.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in software development, primarily with the Java stack.
  • 3+ years of experience managing one or more engineering teams (25+ individuals) in a modern software development environment.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development processes, frameworks, and their practical trade-offs.
  • Knowledge of contemporary software engineering technologies and their applications to real-world problems.
  • Understanding of AI tools, prompting, and workflow automation in software engineering.
  • Ability to assess AI outputs and apply them to improve efficiency and quality.
  • Familiarity with DevOps culture and practices.
  • Strong interpersonal skills combining empathy, business acumen, and the ability to set expectations and provide feedback.
  • Open-mindedness, willingness to learn, and courage to make progress-driving decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Bonus points

  • Experience leading the development of complex, distributed software systems requiring deep domain or technical expertise.
  • Experience with Agile or other value-stream-based framework transformations.
  • Proven success in building high-performing software development teams from the ground up.
  • Experience managing teams using metrics related to motivation, performance, and time.

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Be among like-minded people

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Feel supported by your HR, and take advantage of our referral bonus program.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
raw.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

raw.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on helping women overcome people-pleasing.
raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on helping women overcome people-pleasing. This project will help women unmask the root causes of approval-seeking behaviors, dismantle the fear of man, and live in the genuine freedom of a heart captivated by the fear of God.

We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including:

  • A foundational, theological exploration of the "fear of man" vs. the "fear of God." This book would dive deep into theology to uncover how a woman's craving for human approval is ultimately a worship issue. It would offer a robust, gospel-centered framework for understanding our identity in Christ, freeing women from the exhausting, performance-driven cycle of earning love and acceptance.
  • A vulnerable, narrative-driven book that uses powerful personal storytelling, memoir-style reflection, and relatable lived experiences to expose the daily, heavy toll of people-pleasing. The author will walk readers through her own struggles with boundary-setting, overcommitment, and the fear of rejection—whether in friendships, marriage, ministry, or family dynamics—while highlighting the liberating grace of Jesus.

The ideal project will combine deep empathy and cultural relevance with rich biblical truth, moving past shallow "assertiveness training" to point women to the ultimate security found in Christ alone.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if generative AI is used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the position?
Every player who opens our casino lobby should see something that feels built for them. This role exists to make that happen. You'll help shape and execute the content strategy behind our lobby experience, personalizing what players see across multiple jurisdictions and continuously sharpening it based on what's working in the market.
This isn't a back office execution role. We're looking for someone who's genuinely curious about player behavior, has an eye for what makes a game or category compelling, and wants to help build the next generation of casino content strategy.

Day to day, you will:

  • Execute and maintain personalized content placements across the casino lobby, tailoring the experience by player segment and jurisdiction

  • Conduct ongoing competitor and market research, tracking how other operators structure their lobbies, categories, and promotional content

  • Pitch and help develop new game category concepts based on market trends, player data, and competitive gaps

  • Coordinate content rollouts across multiple jurisdictions, adapting for local regulatory and compliance requirements

  • Partner with content planning, operations, and game launch teams to keep lobby content fresh and aligned with new releases

  • Monitor widget and category performance, flagging what's underperforming and surfacing opportunities to test

  • Support the buildout of internal frameworks and documentation that help the wider team scale personalization efforts

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Experience in content strategy, merchandising, or lobby/category management, ideally in a digital product environment

  • Casino or iGaming experience is a plus but not a requirement

  • Strong instinct for market and competitive research, with the curiosity to dig into what other operators are doing and why

  • Comfort working across multiple jurisdictions with differing rules, timelines, and content requirements

  • Clear, structured written communication for pitching ideas and documenting content decisions

  • Familiarity with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, or willingness to learn

  • An understanding of how personalization and recommendation systems work in a consumer app context is a plus

  • Core daytime hours with occasional flexibility needed around major launches or jurisdictional go-lives

What’s in it for you?
We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques
We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop a Christ-centered book that helps men explore their identity in Christ, understand God’s calling, and live purposefully in family, work, and community. This project should combine personal stories with theological depth with practical guidance that resonates with real-life challenges. The strongest proposals will clearly define the reader and show how the book helps men navigate cultural pressures, form godly character, and embrace their God-given identity and purpose.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project
