What you'll do ✨

  • Manage the strategy and execution of Cold Email and LinkedIn Outreach campaigns for our international clients.
  • Create and review messaging for outbound campaigns using AI, audience research, ICP analysis, and campaign performance insights.
  • Build and improve prospecting and list-building workflows by combining multiple data sources to help our Lead Generation team create high-intent prospect lists.

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists(LP, LPCC, LIMFT, LISW) in Ohio to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 15-25 hours of direct clinical work during evening and/or weekend hours
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Evening Availability Consists of:
      • Monday - Friday: 3:00 - 10:00 PM local time
      • Saturday & Sunday: 8 hours of availability per day
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Ohio: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor, Licensed Independent Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Ohio = $55,000 - $99,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. raw.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
raw.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
raw.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.

raw.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
raw.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The Project Manager plays a key role in planning, coordinating, and delivering complex development projects for Fidus clients, from initial scope through to final delivery. You will work directly with customers, Sales, and Fidus's technical teams to manage project scope, schedule, and budget, and to keep everyone aligned as the project moves from design through implementation.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on project diversity, enjoys building strong relationships across technical and business teams, and takes pride in delivering projects on time, on budget, and to a high standard.

Make an Impact with Us:

At Fidus, you'll lead high-speed, high-complexity electronic system projects, often built on emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll coordinate cross-functional teams spanning FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our clients.

In practice, that means managing projects in areas such as space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video, imaging, VR/AR applications, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. You won't be limited to a single product or industry — your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Plan, deliver, and manage multiple concurrent projects ranging in size from medium to large
  • Coordinate project teams that may be distributed across multiple location sites and disciplines
  • Forge strong partnerships with Sales, the Customer, and the Project Team to ensure efficiency across all aspects of the project
  • Work closely with Sales and Technical Leads to understand project requirements
  • Take independent ownership of project decisions related to scope, schedule, and budget
  • Regularly update customers and internal management on project status via meetings and/or reports
  • Manage project process and resources, including budget and schedules, from design and development through implementation
  • Identify process gaps and implement process improvements at the project level
  • Manage technical negotiations with suppliers

Who You Are:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant technical industry experience, including at least three (3) years of Project Management experience
  • University degree or equivalent
  • Proven track record managing large projects using project management methodologies
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated delivery of innovative solutions to project challenges
  • Experience using project management tracking software, such as Microsoft Project
  • Completed or working towards PMP is an asset
  • Completion of an Engineering degree and previous technical engineering experience is an asset

Location and travel: Fully remote role and travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry — our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can't wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists(LP, LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Pennsylvania to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 15-25 hours of direct clinical work during evening and/or weekend hours
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Evening Availability Consists of:
      • Monday - Friday: 3:00 - 10:00 PM local time
      • Saturday & Sunday: 8 hours of availability per day
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Pennsylvania: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Desirable:

TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST/ HUMAN RESOURCES COORDINATOR (RECRUITER) – INTERN
Work Location:THIS IS A FULLY REMOTE ROLE
Job Type:INTERN TO PERMANENT PLACEMENT

TheTalent Acquisition Specialistis responsible for managing the day-to day recruiting functions for the Sales and Marketing Channels at their respective site(s). TheTalent Acquisition Specialistwill source, screen, set up interviews, and make job offers for all sales and marketing positions at their designated location(s). This position provides ongoing communication and collaboration with all hiring managers regarding the recruitment process within legal and company policies. TheTalent Acquisition Specialistalso collaborates with the Director and/or VP of Business Affairs to analyze reports and trends and to also develop and execute agreed upon recruiting strategies.

Requirements

Develops positive and collaborative partnership with the sales and marketing management channels to build a robust pipeline of talented professionals for a variety of positions for Global Merchant Services. Manages people processes for assigned clientele (quarterly and annual reporting, quarterly and annual employee engagement survey, creative planning exercises, tailored training, etc.). Conducts quarterly and annual on-going review with business candidates to assess business needs and establish and align HR strategy/ action plans as needed.

Responsible for integrating Talent Acquisition/ HR services, solutions and initiatives for business objectives. Maintain a positive employment environment by implementing all HR programs/ processes accurately and timely, ensuring consistency and fairness.

Benefits

Responsible for assessing and identifying talent and assists in establishing individual action plans for future development. Partner with candidate leaders to develop plans and strategies to drive and improve performance management in an effort to align compensation to strategic goals and objectives.

Assists with the development and implementation of ongoing management and non-management training and development programs on topics such as acceptable employment practices, interview guidelines, selection processes, onboarding and retention.

Accountable to accomplish objectives, policies, and defined recruiting goals as defined by the Talent Acquisition strategy. Aggressively recruit for the best qualified candidates from a variety of sources, managing the selection process to include interviewing, assessing candidates, screening and recommending the best final candidates, while filling the staffing needs within a defined timeline.
Provide a high level of customer service and guidance to the departmental hiring managers by consulting with them on recruitment and staffing issues, policies and processes. Source and screen resumes for positions in Sales, Marketing, and Training. Coordinate with candidates and hiring managers to schedule interviews. Ensure timely communications with all candidates and hiring managers upfront and after the interview. Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate information in our recruiting database.

Leverage on-line recruiting resources and In-House Applicant Tracking System to identify and recruit the best candidates. Use social media and web to search for qualified candidates. Stay informed of trends and innovative recruiting techniques in order to be competitive in recruiting practices. Promote Global Merchant Services at a variety of functions such as Career/ Job Fair Events, Colleges and Universities and Sales Organizations/ Events. Build professional networks to build a pipeline of qualified candidates.
Qualifications For Talent Acquisition Specialist/ Human Resources Coordinator
​
  • Professional Human Resources certification strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience seeking talent recruitment and assisting with onboarding processes.
  • Interpersonal skills and ability to communicate professionally.
  • Experience in the continual development of talent pipelines and sourcing potential candidates.
  • Ability to speak knowledgeably about the company and answer any questions a potential hire may have.
  • Firm understanding and implementation of recruiting metrics to drive decision-making is strongly preferred.
  • Proficient in using company software and databases to connect with and reach out to potential candidates.
  • Previous experience developing and executing recruiting marketing and branding strategies.
  • Experience working with a diverse team and striving for fairness in hiring all races, genders and age.

raw.description:
Bist du bereit, deine Studienzeit mit einer Prise echter Berufspraxis zu würzen? Möchtest du Teil eines Teams werden, das nicht nur Erfahrungen sammelt, sondern auch die Qualität unserer Plattformen maßgeblich beeinflusst? Dann werde Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Customer Care bei StudyCheck.

Deine Mission: Qualitätssicherung und mehr!

Du bist unser Prüfprofi. Deine Hauptaufgabe? Die Prüfung von Erfahrungsberichten, denn hey, wir wollen sicherstellen, dass unsere Nutzer stets die besten Informationen erhalten. Aber das ist noch längst nicht alles:

  • Du überprüfst die Datenbankaktualität und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte immer auf dem neuesten Stand sind.

  • Du hältst ein wachsames Auge auf die Kommentierungen zu Erfahrungsberichten, schließlich soll sich bei uns jeder wohl und verstanden fühlen.

Ein Blick in deinen Tag als Werkstudent Customer Care (m/w/d) im Customer Care Team

  • Morgens: Der Startschuss ☕️🍵

Dein Tag startet früh, denn du bist nicht nur Werkstudent im Customer Care bei StudyCheck, sondern auch fleißiger Student. Nachdem du gemütlich aus dem Bett aufgestanden bist, gönnst du dir einen kräftigen Kaffee oder Tee, um wach zu werden.

  • Vormittag: Vorlesungen und Lernen 🎓

Nach einer kurzen Aufwärmphase stürzt du dich in deine morgendlichen Vorlesungen an der Universität. Dort saugst du neues Wissen auf und tauchst in dein Fachgebiet ein.

  • Mittag: Kurze Pause zwischen den Welten 🥪

In der Mittagspause zwischen Uni und Arbeit gönnst du dir eine kulinarische Pause. Ein schnelles Mittagessen oder ein frischer Smoothie gibt dir die nötige Energie, um gestärkt in den Nachmittag zu starten.

  • Nachmittag: Daten pflegen und Erfahrungsberichte prüfen 👩‍💻🔍

Am Nachmittag wechselst du wieder in den Customer Care-Modus. Du widmest dich unserer Datenbank und bearbeitest die eingegangenen Erfahrungsberichte. Datenbankaktualisierung, Abgleich mit den Hochschulangeboten und Überprüfung von Inhalten stehen auf deiner Agenda.

  • Abend: Lernen und Erfolge feiern 🥳🎉

Nach einem vollen Tag von Vorlesungen, Arbeit und Lernen ist der Abend deine wohlverdiente Freizeit. Hier kannst du dich entspannen, mit Freunden treffen oder deinen persönlichen Interessen nachgehen

Requirements

Oh, doch wo bleiben unsere Manieren? Wir haben uns ja noch gar nicht vorgestellt!

Hi, wir sind das Team von StudyCheck. 👋

Wir sind der Motor hinter StudyCheck mit stolzen monatlichen 4 Millionen Seitenaufrufen betreiben wir Deutschlands führende Online-Portale zur Studienorientierung - StudyCheck und FernstudiumCheck. Unsere Partnerschaft erstreckt sich über mehr als 870 renommierte Bildungsanbieter, darunter Universitäten, Hochschulen und Fern(hoch)schulen. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2008 revolutionieren wir, wie Menschen im Internet Bildungsangebote entdecken.

Übrigens, StudyCheck ist eine eingetragene Marke der: OAK - Online Akademie GmbH

Warum DU bei uns als Werkstudent Customer Care (m/w/d) arbeiten solltest? Ganz einfach, hier sind einige unschlagbare Vorteile:

💪Flexible & faire Arbeitszeiten

Bei uns bestimmst du, wann du am produktivsten bist. Egal, ob du ein Frühaufsteher oder eine Nachteule bist, du kannst deine Arbeit in Abstimmung mit deinem Studium und deinem persönlichen Rhythmus gestalten. Und das Beste? Du kannst dies bequem von überall erledigen, denn die Arbeit ist remote.

💪 Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeit auch bezüglich des Aufgabengebietes

Dein Potenzial kennt keine Grenzen. Hier bekommst du die einzigartige Gelegenheit, über den Tellerrand zu schauen und deine Fähigkeiten in verschiedenen Bereichen auszubauen. Das bedeutet ständiges Wachstum und spannende Herausforderungen, die deine berufliche Entwicklung vorantreiben.

Die Position passt perfekt zu dir, wenn...

  • Du deine Arbeitszeit von 20 Stunden pro Woche ideal in deinen Studienalltag integrieren kannst.

  • Du eine strukturierte Eigenorganisation mitbringst und Aufgaben zielgerichtet angehst.

  • Du technisch versiert bist und im Umgang mit dem Laptop souverän agierst.

  • Du dich durch Zuverlässigkeit auszeichnest und in offener und kommunikativer Art überzeugst.

  • Du ein schnelles und sinnentnehmendes Textverständnis besitzt sowie ein gutes Urteilsvermögen und Analysefähigkeiten demonstrierst.

Klingt voll nach dir? Dann bewirb dich gleich hier mit deinem Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil. Wir verlangen kein Anschreiben von dir, da draußen ist schließlich 2026.

Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören (und melden uns in jedem Fall zurück!)

Highlights

Werkstudent Customer Care (m/w/d) bei StudyCheck, Deutschlands führendem Portal zur Studienorientierung: Erfahrungsberichte prüfen, Studiengänge pflegen. 20 Std./Woche, remote, flexibel.

raw.description:
Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager

Role Summary

We are seeking an analytical and action-oriented Real Estate Transactions Manager to be the “engine room” of our infrastructure acquisition team. In this role, you will take identified sites and drive them from initial interest to a signed lease or purchase agreement. You’ll specialize in high-power EV charging sites, vehicle service centers, and parking facilities.

You will not just track deals; you will actively unblock them. You will serve as the central node connecting Legal, Finance, Technical and external broker teams, aggregating their inputs into clear, actionable Deal Summaries for our Investment Committee. Your goal is to maximize pipeline velocity while minimizing risk.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pipeline & Transaction Management

  • Funnel Velocity:Manage a high volume of active real estate transactions simultaneously, ensuring sites meet our location, technical and cost requirements, track critical dates and hold stakeholders accountable to timelines.

  • Negotiation Support:Outline key terms for Letters of Intent (LOIs). Partner with legal counsel to redline leases and related contracts, ensuring commercial terms align with company targets.

  • Deal Closing: Manage the closing checklist, ensuring all contingencies (zoning, title, survey, environmental) are cleared prior to execution.

  • Collaborate with local teams:Coordinate and streamline communication between Moove headquarters and the Japan team, driving efficient information sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and decision-making for real estate transactions.

2. Cross-Functional Due Diligence

  • The “Quarterback”:Act as the central point of contact during the diligence period. You are responsible for pulling in the right experts at the right time.

    • Construction & Utilities:Coordinate with the project delivery teams of external partners to validate site buildability and power availability (MW capacity).

    • Legal:Coordinate with internal and external counsel to advance zoning, land use, and permitting reviews.

    • Finance:Collaborate to ensure deal economics fit within our CAPEX and OPEX models.

3. Investment Analysis & Reporting

  • Deal Summaries:Synthesize complex data—financial models, site layouts, risk assessments, and legal constraints—into concise Investment Committee (IC) Memos that drive “Go/No-Go” decisions.

  • Financial Modeling:Run pro formas and sensitivity analyses to test deal viability under different scenarios (e.g., changing utility rates, construction cost variances).

  • Database Management: Maintain the “Single Source of Truth” in our real estate database (e.g., Google Sheets, Asana), ensuring all deal data is accurate and up to date.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience, including a minimum of 3+ years of direct experience in commercial real estate transactions, development, or real estate private equity

  • The “Closer” Mindset:Demonstrated experience managing transactions from LOI to execution. You understand the mechanics of a real estate deal.

  • Analytical Skills:Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (financial modeling)

  • Language Skills:Business-level proficiency in both Japanese and English (written and spoken)

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business, or a related field

  • Experience with infrastructure or industrial assets (e.g., data centers, solar farms, logistics, or EV charging)

  • Understanding of municipal zoning and land-use entitlements

  • Familiarity with commercial or industrial real estate leases

  • Familiarity with Japanese real estate market dynamics, local regulations, and public bidding processes

Success Attributes

  • Structured Thinker:You can take a messy email thread involving a lawyer, an engineer, and a landlord, and turn it into a clear list of action items.

  • Bias for Action:You don’t wait for permission to follow up, remove blockers and rally cross-team efforts.

  • Risk Radar:You have an eye for detail and can spot “deal killers” (like a restrictive easement or a bad indemnity clause) early in the process.

  • Collaborative:You understand that getting a deal done requires building consensus across multiple internal teams with competing priorities.

Working Conditions (Statutory Disclosure)

1. Position

  • Job Title:Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager

  • Legal Employer:Deel Japan K.K.

  • Contract Type: Indefinite term (正社員). No fixed-term renewal limit applies.

  • Employment Structure:This position is legally employed by Deel Japan K.K.

2. Duties & Scope of Change

  • Initial Duties: Identify a pipeline of real estate assets (lease and purchase) supporting fleet operations, including EV charging, parking and vehicle servicing depots; conduct due diligence and financial analysis; and lead contracting negotiations. Full responsibilities are set out above.

  • Scope of Change:May be reassigned to other duties within the Infrastructure team based on business needs.

3. Work Location & Scope of Change

  • Initial Location:Fully remote within Japan

  • Scope of Change:Remote work policy is subject to change based on company guidelines.

  • Passive Smoking Prevention:No designated company worksite; work is performed remotely. Smoking is prohibited at any company-arranged premises or event.

4. Working Hours & Overtime

  • Working Hours:9:00 – 18:00 JST

  • Break:60 minutes, taken at the employee’s election before 16:00

  • Scheduled Hours:8 hours per day / 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Overtime:Yes — an average of approximately 4.2 hours per week (18 hours per month)

5. Compensation

  • Total Annual:¥9,750,000 – ¥11,250,000 (gross)

  • Base Salary:¥8,569,507 – ¥9,887,892 per year (¥714,126 – ¥823,991 per month), excluding the fixed overtime allowance

  • Fixed Overtime Allowance (固定残業手当): ¥1,180,493 – ¥1,362,108 per year (¥98,374 – ¥113,509 per month), paid as 18 hours of overtime per month

  • Overtime Beyond the Fixed Hours:Overtime in excess of 18 hours per month is paid additionally at the statutory premium rate.

  • Payment Schedule:Calculated at month end, paid on the 1st of the following month by bank transfer

  • Bonus: None

  • Commuter Allowance:None — this is a fully remote role. Business travel required by the Company is reimbursed separately.

6. Time Off & Holidays

  • Days Off:Saturdays, Sundays, and the 16 national public holidays

  • Annual Holidays (年間休日):120 days (104 weekend days plus 16 national public holidays)

  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days granted after 6 months of continuous service with at least 80% attendance, increasing with length of service in accordance with the Labor Standards Act. At least 5 days must be taken each year.

  • Sick Leave:3 days of company-paid sick leave per year, in addition to statutory social-insurance benefits. A medical certificate is required for absences beyond 3 consecutive days.

  • Other Leave:Maternity, paternity/parental, childcare and family caregiver leave in accordance with Japanese law

7. Benefits & Insurance

  • Social Insurance:Enrollment in all mandatory social insurances: Health Insurance, Employees’ Pension, Employment Insurance, and Workers’ Compensation Insurance

  • Private Medical Insurance:Allianz, Gold – Single plan, provided in addition to statutory social insurance

8. Probation & Notice

  • Probation:3 months from the date of hire, with no extension

  • Conditions During Probation:Working conditions and salary remain unchanged.

  • Notice Period: 30 days during and after the probationary period

9. Non-Discrimination

No requirement or preference relating to age, gender, or nationality is stated or implied in this posting.

用地取得マネージャー

（Commercial Real Estate Transactions Manager）

職務概要

当社はインフラ用地取得チームの中核を担っていただける、分析力と行動力を兼ね備えた用地取得マネージャーを募集しています。候補地の発掘から、リース契約または売買契約の締結に至るまで、一連の取引を推進していただく仕事です。

単に案件の進捗を管理するだけでなく、案件が滞っている要因を見つけて自ら解消していく姿勢が求められます。法務・財務・技術部門、そして外部の仲介業者をつなぐ窓口として各方面からの情報を集約し、投資委員会に向けて分かりやすい案件サマリーにまとめていただきます。案件を進めるスピードを最大化しながら、リスクを最小限に抑えることが目標です。

主な業務内容

1. パイプライン・取引管理

  • パイプライン管理：複数の不動産取引を同時に進行させ、立地・技術・コスト面の要件を満たしているかを確認しながら、重要な期限を管理し、関係者が計画通りに動けるよう働きかけます。

  • 交渉サポート： LOI（意向表明書）の主要条件を整理します。法務担当と連携してリース契約や関連契約の内容を確認・修正し、商業条件が会社の目標に沿うよう調整します。

  • 契約締結：クロージングに向けたチェックリストを管理し、契約締結前に必要な条件（用途地域、権利関係、測量、環境調査など）がすべて解消されていることを確認します。

  • 現地チームとの連携：Moove本社と日本チーム間のコミュニケーションを調整・円滑化し、不動産取引に関する情報共有、部門横断的な協働、意思決定を推進します。

2. 部門横断のデューデリジェンス

  • デューデリジェンス期間中の窓口として、必要なタイミングで適切な専門家を巻き込みます。

    • 建設・インフラ設備：外部パートナーのプロジェクトチームと連携し、用地の開発可能性や電力容量（MW）を確認します。

    • 法務：社内外の弁護士と連携し、用途地域・土地利用・許認可に関する審査を進めます。

    • 財務： 案件の採算が会社のCAPEX・OPEXモデルに合致するよう連携します。

3. 投資分析・レポーティング

  • 案件サマリー作成：財務モデル、敷地レイアウト、リスク評価、法的制約といった複雑な情報を整理し、投資委員会（IC）向けの簡潔なメモにまとめ、実行可否の判断材料を提供します。

  • 財務モデリング：プロフォーマ（将来収支予測）や感応度分析を行い、電気料金や建設コストの変動など様々なシナリオのもとで案件の採算性を検証します。

  • データベース管理：不動産データベース（Google Sheets、Asanaなど）を常に最新かつ正確な状態に保ちます。

応募資格

必須要件

  • 学歴： 大卒以上

  • 経験： 実務経験7年以上、うち3年以上は商業用不動産取引、開発、または不動産プライベートエクイティにおける直接的な経験

  • クロージング経験： LOIから契約締結まで、案件をやり遂げた経験。不動産取引の一連の流れを理解していること

  • 分析力： Excel・Google Sheetsを用いた財務モデリングの経験

  • 語学力： 日本語・英語ともにビジネスレベル（読み書き・会話）

歓迎要件

  • 不動産、金融、経営学等の学位をお持ちの方

  • インフラ・産業用アセット（データセンター、太陽光発電所、物流施設、EV充電インフラなど）における経験

  • 用途地域や土地利用に関する法規制の理解

  • 商業用・産業用不動産の賃貸借契約に関する知識

  • 日本の不動産市場動向、各種規制、公募入札プロセスへの理解

求める人物像

  • 論理的思考力： 弁護士やエンジニア、地権者が入り乱れる複雑なメールのやり取りを整理し、明確なアクションリストに落とし込むことができる。

  • 主体性： 指示を待つのではなく、自らフォローアップを行い、障害を取り除き、部門を横断して周囲を巻き込みながら前に進められる。

  • リスク管理能力： 細部への注意力があり、制限的な地役権や不利な補償条項など、案件を左右しかねないリスクを早い段階で見抜くことができる。

  • 協調性： 案件を成立させるために、優先順位の異なる複数の社内チームとの合意形成をリードできる。

労働条件明示

職業安定法に基づく明示事項（2024年4月1日追加分を含む）

1. 募集職種

  • 職種名：用地取得マネージャー

  • 雇用主（募集者名）：Deel Japan 株式会社

  • 契約期間：期間の定めなし（正社員）。有期契約の更新上限の定めはありません。

  • 雇用区分： 本ポジションは、Deel Japan 株式会社との雇用契約に基づき同社に雇用されます。

2. 従事すべき業務の内容および変更の範囲

  • 雇入れ直後の業務：フリート事業（EV充電設備、駐車場、車両整備拠点等）を支える不動産（賃貸・購入）のパイプライン構築、デューデリジェンスおよび財務分析の実施、契約交渉の主導。詳細は上記職務内容のとおり。

  • 変更の範囲：会社の業務上の必要に応じ、インフラチーム内の他の業務に配置転換となる可能性があります。

3. 就業場所および変更の範囲

  • 雇入れ直後の就業場所：日本国内の完全リモート勤務

  • 変更の範囲： リモートワーク方針は、会社の規定により変更となる場合があります。

  • 受動喫煙防止措置： 会社が指定する就業場所はなく、業務はリモートで行います。会社が手配する施設および行事における喫煙は禁止です。

4. 労働時間および時間外労働

  • 所定労働時間：9:00 〜 18:00（日本時間）

  • 休憩時間：60分（16:00までの間に従業員の裁量で取得）

  • 所定労働：1日8時間 / 週40時間（月曜〜金曜）

  • 時間外労働： あり（週平均 約4.2時間／月18時間）

5. 賃金

  • 年収（総額）： 9,750,000円 〜 11,250,000円

  • 基本給：年額 8,569,507円 〜 9,887,892円（月額 714,126円 〜 823,991円）／固定残業手当を除く

  • 固定残業手当： 年額 1,180,493円 〜 1,362,108円（月額 98,374円 〜 113,509円）。時間外労働の有無にかかわらず、月18時間分の時間外手当として支給します。

  • 超過分の取扱い：月18時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は、法定の割増率により追加で支給します。

  • 賃金支払日：月末締め、翌月1日に銀行振込にて支払い

  • 賞与： なし

  • 通勤手当： なし（完全リモート勤務のため）。会社が指示する出張の費用は別途実費を支給します。

6. 休日・休暇

  • 休日： 土曜・日曜・国民の祝日（年16日）

  • 年間休日：120日（土日104日＋国民の祝日16日）

  • 年次有給休暇： 入社後6か月間継続勤務し、全労働日の8割以上出勤した場合に10日付与。以降は労働基準法に従い勤続年数に応じて増加します。年5日は必ず取得していただきます。

  • 病気休暇：法定の社会保険給付に加え、会社負担の有給病気休暇を年3日付与。3日を超えて連続して欠勤する場合は診断書の提出が必要です。

  • その他の休暇：産前産後休業、育児休業、出生時育児休業、介護休業（いずれも法令に基づく）

7. 福利厚生・保険

This makes the role ideal for licensed HCPs in the UK (GMC validated) who have a part-time role or work as a locum and therefore have more time throughout the day, as well as retired doctors or those working from home, who can ensure they're available to pick up video consultations as they arise.

By collaborating with major insurance companies, governments, and NGOs, we have built a strong foundation of trust and reliability within the healthcare industry. Our diverse team of hundreds of doctors caters to individuals across 60 countries, speaking 27 different languages, and we are excited to extend our services to the people of the UK.

Requirements

  • Medical Degree + Residency completion – at least 3 years post residency completion. All specialities are welcomed to apply.
  • Valid Medical License in the UK (GMC registered).
  • Up to date DBS check.
  • Indemnity cover.

  • Provide timely and accurate medical advice remotely.

Benefits

Join us in our mission to revolutionise healthcare services in the UK. Apply now and become a valuable part of the Abi Global Health team. Together, let's make quality healthcare accessible to all.

Abi Global Health is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for all employees.

Send your updated CV highlighting your relevant experience. We look forward to welcoming you to our dynamic team at Abi Global Health!

raw.description:
A Rhythm Remote Device Clinician remotely monitors patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) utilizing Rhythm’s proprietary software. This specialist employs knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology and biomedical engineering concepts to assess the technical function of the patient’s CIED, analyze and interpret device and patient diagnostics, and perform accurate clinical documentation as determined by Rhythm’s best practice standards.

Rhythm offers full-time employees a robust compensation and benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage, 401k retirement savings with company match, paid time off and more.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Integrate a knowledge base from physiology, pathophysiology, and cardiac device function to perform competent evaluations, diagnostic reviews, and overall analysis through remote monitoring.
  • Recognize abnormal functions of pacemakers, defibrillators, ILRs, and CRT devices, and recommend strategies to address and correct issues.
  • Communicate with Rhythm’s clinical team and providers regarding CIED function and diagnostic data through accurate, professional, and standardized documentation.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and adhere to all Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and Protected Health Information (PHI) standards/protocols.
  • Support and contribute to Rhythm’s patient-centered care philosophy: Every team member is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient.

Requirements

    • Bachelor's or associate degree required OR experience in a related field—nursing, medicine, electronics, or engineering.
    • Successful completion of a cardiac device rhythm management course or equivalent experience.
    • 2+ years of recent implanted cardiac device management experience with knowledge of all manufacturer programmers.
    • 3+ years cardiology experience, cardiac electrophysiology preferred.
    • Experience with interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for all four major manufacturers (Medtronic, Abbott/St. Jude, Boston Scientific, Biotronik).
    • Cardiac rhythm management industry training and experience preferred.
    • Certified Rhythm Analysis Technician (CRAT) required prior to employment commencement date.
    • Additional preferred certifications—Certified Cardiographic Technician (CCT), Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist (RCES), International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners (IBHRE) Certifications (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) also preferred, prior to employment date.
    • Proficiency with collaboration applications and software (Microsoft Office Suite, Teams).

Benefits

    • Fully Remote: You’ll need access to a quiet working environment, high speed internet. We’ll provide you with a computer and additional monitor to support your work.
    • Schedule: You operate within our business hours (9a-5p ET Monday through Friday). We can be slightly flexible on hours depending on location.
    • Salary range: $70,000-$75,000 depending on experience; Clinicians are incentivized to bonus and have the ability to make an additional $10,000+ annually based on the number of reports completed.

raw.title: Chief Operating Officer
raw.excerpt: About World Business Lenders • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses.
raw.description:
About World Business Lenders

  • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.
  • Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

  • The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for providing operational leadership and coordination across the Company’s Lending Operations, including Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing, as well as Asset Resolution and Loan Administration (Servicing).
  • This role will work closely with the senior leadership responsible for each function to ensure these areas operate as an integrated, end-to-end lending and asset lifecycle.
  • The Chief Operating Officer will focus on improving coordination within and between departments, establishing consistent processes and performance standards, identifying operational bottlenecks, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring that issues are addressed before they negatively impact lending, servicing, or asset resolution.
  • The Chief Operating Officer will focus on process integration, performance standards, operational efficiency, cross-functional coordination, and resolution of issues across the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
  • The position will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will serve as a key operational partner to executive leadership. The role will provide visibility into operational performance, risks, capacity, and opportunities for improvement across the functions within its scope.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve coordination and accountability across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration.
  • Reduce operational bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs.
  • Improve turnaround times and overall process efficiency.
  • Establish clear and measurable operational KPIs and improve visibility into performance for executive leadership.
  • Identify and resolve recurring operational issues.
  • Build scalable processes capable of supporting the company's continued growth.
  • Create a unified and efficient end-to-end operating model across the lending, servicing, and asset-resolution lifecycle.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

  • Operational Leadership
    • Provide overall operational oversight across Lending Operations (Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing), Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration (Servicing).
    • Work directly with the functional leaders of each area to establish priorities, processes, performance expectations, and operational objectives.
    • Ensure the functions within Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration operate as an integrated process, with clear ownership and accountability for cross-departmental workflows.
    • Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and communication breakdowns across the closing and asset lifecycle.
    • Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, workflows, controls, service-level expectations, and escalation processes.
    • Monitor operational performance and provide regular updates and recommendations to the CEO.
  • Closing Operations Oversight
    • Work with Closing Operations leadership to monitor closing, funding, and related operational activities.
    • Identify recurring issues affecting Closing Operations or movement through the closing pipeline.
    • Coordinate with Valuations, Asset Resolution, Underwriting, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other relevant functions to improve execution.
    • Review operational reporting and identify trends requiring management attention.
  • Valuations Oversight
    • Work with Valuations leadership to ensure valuation activities are properly integrated into closing and asset-resolution processes.
    • Monitor valuation volume, turnaround times, quality, exceptions, and outstanding requests.
    • Identify delays that affect closing, underwriting, or asset resolution and establish appropriate prioritization and escalation processes.
    • Identify opportunities to improve valuation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
  • Asset Resolution Oversight
    • Work with Asset Resolution leadership to ensure assets move efficiently through the resolution process.
    • Monitor resolution pipelines, aging, recoveries, dispositions, and other relevant operational metrics.
    • Identify operational issues affecting resolution outcomes and improve coordination with Closing Operations, Valuations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders.
    • Establish consistent processes for tracking assets through resolution and escalating matters requiring executive attention.
    • Identify opportunities to improve recovery outcomes, reduce cycle times, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Lending Operations Oversight
    • Provide operational oversight across Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing.
    • Work with functional leaders to establish priorities, service levels, performance expectations, and escalation processes.
    • Identify bottlenecks, handoff issues, capacity constraints, and recurring problems across the lending pipeline.
    • Monitor operational reporting and KPIs across the lending lifecycle and recommend corrective actions.
  • Loan Administration (Servicing) Oversight
    • Provide operational oversight of Loan Administration (Servicing) and its integration with the broader lending and asset lifecycle.
    • Monitor servicing workflows, performance, capacity, exceptions, and cross-functional dependencies.
    • Identify opportunities to improve servicing efficiency, consistency, reporting, and coordination with Lending Operations and Asset Resolution.
    • Establish appropriate escalation and accountability processes for servicing issues that affect portfolio performance or customer outcomes.
  • End-to-End Process Management
    • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company's end-to-end closing and asset lifecycle.
    • Map key processes across Closing Operations, Valuations, and Asset Resolution and clarify handoffs and responsibilities.
    • Develop dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that provide visibility into operational performance.
    • Analyze operational data to identify trends, capacity constraints, recurring problems, and improvement opportunities.
    • Lead cross-functional initiatives designed to improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and profitability.
    • Ensure process changes are appropriately communicated, documented, and implemented.
  • People & Organizational Leadership
    • Evaluate staffing levels, workload, capacity, and organizational structure across the operational functions.
    • Identify needs for additional resources, technology, training, or process changes.
    • Establish expectations for operational accountability and performance management.
    • Support the development of department leaders and appropriate succession and coverage within key operational functions.
    • Help establish an organizational structure that can scale with the company's growth.
    • Encourage collaboration and accountability across departments.
  • Executive & Cross-Functional Responsibilities
    • Serve as the primary operational liaison across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, Loan Administration, and executive leadership.
    • Serve as the operational bridge between functional operating teams and executive leaders responsible for Technology, Data & Analytics, and Finance to ensure systems, reporting, automation, resource planning, and performance objectives support the Company's broader operational strategy.
    • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that connect operational processes with technology, data, and financial performance, ensuring that operational decisions and process improvements are evaluated from an end-to-end perspective.
    • Partner closely with the CIO, CDAO, and CFO to ensure operational teams are aligned with the Company's technology and automation strategy, data and reporting infrastructure, and financial planning and performance objectives.
    • Partner with Finance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Sales, Lending Operations, and other departments on cross-functional operational matters.
    • Prepare operational reports, analysis, and recommendations for the CEO and executive leadership.
    • Escalate significant operational risks, delays, resource constraints, and performance issues to the CEO.
    • Participate in strategic planning and operational decision-making.
    • Lead special projects and other initiatives assigned by the CEO.
    • Evaluate opportunities to improve the company's operational infrastructure and scalability.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.

Required Experience:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in operations, lending, financial services, commercial finance, asset management, or a related industry.
  • Experience managing or coordinating multiple operational functions.
  • Experience working with senior-level leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of closing operations and the loan lifecycle.
  • Experience with valuations, asset resolution, servicing, collections, or related functions strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience improving business processes and operational efficiency.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret operational data and translate it into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence without unnecessarily duplicating the authority of functional department heads.

Core Competencies

  • Operational Leadership
  • Cross-Functional Management
  • Process Improvement
  • Closing Operations
  • Performance Management
  • Data Analysis
  • Problem Solving
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Accountability
  • Executive Communication
  • Change Management

Benefits

What We Offer

🏖️ Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage; a 401(k) with company match; and paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

🌍 Work Environment: This is a remote role with occasional travel.

This is a remote position.

Copywriter | Coaching & Personal Brand
Location:Remote, South Africa
Engagement Type:Independent Contractor | Part-Time, Ongoing
Working Hours:20 hours per week, with some overlap with Perth business hours (AWST)
Rate:AUD $10–$20 per hour (approximately R115–R230 per hour)
Estimated Monthly Earnings:Approximately R10,000–R20,000, depending on hours worked and the exchange rate

About Us

Limitless is a coaching brand founded by Lezly Kaye, based in Perth, Australia.

We help business owners scale through strong teams and remote operations, so they can grow without being the one holding everything together. We also run retreats for women who are building big businesses and big lives.

Our audience is ambitious, self-aware and ready for the next level. Our content needs to speak to that with clarity, warmth and conviction.

The Role

We're looking for a genuine copywriter. Not a VA who writes, and not someone who simply runs prompts through AI and tidies up the output.

We want someone who understands persuasion, voice and structure, and who can make a reader stop, feel seen and take action.

You'll write across multiple channels, helping us communicate our message consistently while capturing the founder's unique voice.

This is an ongoing, part-time opportunity for an experienced writer who enjoys creating meaningful content and understands how words influence decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write compelling YouTube scripts and video hooks.

  • Create engaging social media captions for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook.

  • Develop email newsletters and nurture sequences.

  • Write landing pages, sales pages and launch copy.

  • Create lead magnets and webinar copy.

  • Capture and consistently reflect the founder's voice across different content formats.

  • Apply direct-response copywriting principles, including hooks, offers, objections and calls to action.

  • Incorporate feedback and refine copy to meet the intended message, tone and purpose.

  • Deliver high-quality content within agreed deadlines.


Requirements

  • At least 2 years of paid copywriting experience, ideally within coaching, personal development, online education or service-based businesses.

  • A portfolio demonstrating both short-form and long-form copywriting, including hooks, captions, emails or sales pages.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn a founder's voice and write consistently in that style.

  • Solid understanding of direct-response copywriting principles, including hooks, offers, objections and calls to action.

  • Excellent written English with a natural, conversational tone.

  • Strong understanding of persuasion, storytelling and content structure.

  • Reliability with deadlines and the ability to take feedback and iterate quickly.

  • Availability for some overlap with Perth business hours (AWST), which is 6 hours ahead of South Africa.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience writing for founders or personal brands.

  • Familiarity with YouTube content strategy or funnels.

  • Experience writing launch copy for programs or events.


Benefits

Working Arrangements & Remuneration

  • Fully remote, South Africa.

  • Independent contractor engagement.

  • Part-time, 20 hours per week, ongoing.

  • AUD $10–$20 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio.

  • Approximate ZAR equivalent: R115–R230 per hour.

  • Estimated monthly earnings: R10,000–R20,000, based on approximately 20 hours per week.

  • Some working-hours overlap with Perth, Western Australia (AWST).

  • Paid trial task for shortlisted applicants.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with a portfolio demonstrating your copywriting experience.

Your portfolio should include examples of both short-form and long-form copy, such as social media captions, YouTube hooks, email sequences, landing pages or sales pages.

We'd also love to hear briefly about your experience writing for founders, coaches or personal brands.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial task as part of the recruitment process.

Job Title: Senior Network Design Engineer

Department: Service Management Office > Network Operation Center

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Location: Remote, but located in the Spokane Valley, WA area

About NoaNet

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at

Why Work Here?

  • Overtime opportunities
  • Lease vehicle eligibility (where applicable)
  • Cell phone stipend (where applicable)
  • Travel reimbursement
  • Tuition reimbursement for approved job-related degree programs

Career Overview

NoaNet is seeking a qualified Senior Network Design Engineer responsible for the design, implementation, expansion, and lifecycle support of carrier-grade IP/MPLS, Ethernet, PON, LTE/wireless, and optical networks. This position serves as a senior technical authority for network architecture, customer solutions, complex implementations, and escalated operational issues. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Sales, customers, and vendor partners from initial requirements through implementation and operational turnover.

Responsibilities

  • Design and engineer carrier-grade core, distribution, and access network solutions using IP/MPLS, Ethernet, optical transport, PON, LTE, wireless, and associated backhaul technologies.
  • Develop high-level and low-level network designs, equipment selections, bills of material, implementation plans, migration plans, and Methods of Procedure (MOPs).
  • Lead network capacity planning and system-requirement definition, and provide technical leadership for equipment and vendor evaluation and selection.
  • Lead or support complex network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and service turn-ups from concept through operational acceptance.
  • Design, deploy, configure, administer, and support PON systems and services, including provisioning through Nokia Altiplano, as well as LTE, wireless, and associated backhaul systems.
  • Establish network design standards and provide senior-level review and approval of network designs, configurations, standards, and implementation plans developed by others.
  • Serve as a senior engineering escalation point for complex multi-vendor network and service issues, including the highest-severity business-impacting outages that reach Engineering.
  • Develop and maintain network standards, design documentation, diagrams, technical support documentation, and operational handoff materials.
  • Partner with Project Management to identify technical dependencies, risks, resource needs, and implementation sequencing for assigned projects.
  • Lead customer professional-services engagements, including requirements gathering, network assessments, architecture and detailed design, equipment and vendor evaluation, implementation and migration planning, deployment and turn-up support, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to provide technical sales support, define solution scope and equipment requirements, and present technical solutions to customers and prospective customers.
  • Architect new services and potential fiber routes, and participate in the research, evaluation, and development of network technologies and equipment platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineering and operations personnel as appropriate.

Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Typically 8 or more years of progressively responsible experience designing, implementing, and supporting service-provider or large-scale enterprise networks.

  • Advanced knowledge of IP/MPLS network architecture, design, and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced understanding of IP routing, including BGP and interior gateway protocols such as OSPF.
  • Strong understanding of MPLS services and concepts, including L2/L3 VPNs, VRFs, resiliency, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced understanding of Ethernet switching and Carrier Ethernet concepts, including VLANs, QinQ, link aggregation, and Layer 2 service design.
  • Experience designing and troubleshooting high-capacity WAN and backbone networks, including 10G, 100G, and higher-speed interfaces.
  • Working knowledge of DWDM and optical transport concepts and components, including wavelengths, optical budgets, amplification, ROADMs, and coherent optics.
  • Experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting QoS for WAN and service-provider networks.
  • Strong network troubleshooting skills, including the safe use of debug/trace tools, packet captures, logs, protocol analysis, and vendor diagnostic capabilities in production environments.
  • Knowledge of network security design and operations, including authentication/AAA, firewalls, remote access, access control lists, role and password management, and configuration management.
  • Ability to independently organize and prioritize work, manage changing priorities, and handle multiple complex technical assignments concurrently.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or another applicable engineering discipline is strongly preferred.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification, Professional Engineer (PE) licensure, or demonstrated eligibility and active progress toward professional engineering licensure is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multi-vendor service-provider or telecommunications network environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Nokia SR OS routing platforms, Juniper routing platforms, Cisco switching platforms, and ADVA/Adtran or comparable optical transport systems.
  • Experience with PON management and provisioning platforms such as Nokia Altiplano, and with LTE, microwave, or other wireless access and backhaul systems.
  • Experience with network automation, scripting, APIs, or data-driven network management. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Git, Linux, NETCONF/RESTCONF, model-driven management, telemetry, and SNMP is desirable.
  • Experience leading technical projects or workstreams from concept development through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Experience developing technical presentations, solution documentation, and customer-facing network designs.

Availability and Travel Requirements:

  • Primary job location: Washington State. Residency in WA, OR, or ID is required.
  • Frequent travel is required; the position should be based in a location with convenient access to air travel.
  • Participation in engineering escalation and on-call support for network outages is required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 25+ pounds

Working Conditions:

  • Work is normally performed in an office environment with long periods of computer work.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote and collaborative

Driving Requirements

  • Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

Location

  • Remote home office located in the State of Washington.

Wage

  • Salary range $110,000
    - $150,000/year DOE.
  • Exempt position.

Benefits

  • Defined Benefit Retirement Plan through the WA State Department of Retirement Systems
  • 457b Optional Supplement Plan
  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
  • Accidental Death and Long Term Disability Plan
  • Combined Paid Leave
  • 11 Paid Holidays

EEO: We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or another characteristic protected by law.

Disclaimer: The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, and responsibilities required of employees assigned to this job.

Salary: $110k - $150k DOE
