Insurance Verification, Disability

and FMLA Support

Remote | Neurology Facility | 40 Hours/Week | $5-$6/hour

Role Overview

The Virtual Medical Assistant will support a neurology facility with insurance verification, disability-related documentation, medical records requests, patient communication, and general administrative duties.

This role requires someone who is highly organized, comfortable handling sensitive patient information, and capable of managing multiple requests accurately and professionally. The ideal candidate should have prior experience supporting a healthcare facility, particularly with insurance, patient documentation, medical records, and electronic health record systems.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and financial responsibility.

  • Contact insurance companies to clarify incomplete or conflicting information.

  • Document verification results accurately in the patient's electronic health record.

Disability and ADA Accommodation Requests (Americans with Disabilities Act)

  • Receive and organize disability-related and ADA accommodation requests.

  • Collect required documents and route requests to the appropriate provider or team member.

  • Track pending requests and follow up to support timely completion.

FMLA Documentation (Family and Medical Leave Act)

  • Receive, review, and organize FMLA forms and supporting documents.

  • Upload forms to the patient record and route them to the provider for clinical completion.

  • Track deadlines and securely return completed forms to authorized recipients.

Medical Records Requests

  • Receive and review medical records requests and patient authorizations.

  • Retrieve and organize the requested records according to facility procedures.

  • Securely release records and document all actions taken.

Patient and Telephone Support

  • Answer incoming calls and respond to patient questions within the scope of the role.

  • Document messages accurately and create telephone or office encounters.

  • Route clinical concerns and urgent requests to the appropriate care team member.

Electronic Health Record Support

  • Create and update office, telephone, and administrative encounters.

  • Upload forms, authorizations, and supporting documents to the correct patient chart.

  • Assign messages and tasks to the appropriate provider or department.

General Administrative Support

  • Monitor assigned work queues, messages, forms, and follow-up lists.

  • Assist with scheduling, data entry, document preparation, and other administrative tasks.

  • Follow established workflows and escalate concerns requiring clinical or supervisory review.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Insurance Verification Specialist, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Familiarity with disability requests, ADA accommodation requests, FMLA forms, or medical records processing.

  • Experience using an electronic health record or electronic medical record system.

  • Strong telephone communication and patient service skills.

  • Ability to create and document office or telephone encounters accurately.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple pending requests.

  • Knowledge of HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and secure handling of medical information.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

  • Reliable internet connection, computer equipment, and a quiet professional workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting a neurology practice or neurological care facility.

  • Experience communicating with insurance companies, employers, disability administrators, or records departments.

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, particularly terminology commonly used in neurology.

  • Experience handling high volumes of calls, forms, patient messages, and documentation requests.

  • Experience working remotely with a provider or multidisciplinary care team.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  • Organization and task prioritization

  • Patient-centered communication

  • Professional telephone etiquette

  • Confidentiality and sound judgment

  • Follow-through and deadline management

  • Written documentation skills

  • Adaptability and willingness to handle varied administrative duties

  • Ability to recognize when a request requires clinical or supervisory escalation

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Complete insurance verification and administrative requests accurately and within established timelines.

  • Maintain organized documentation for disability, ADA, FMLA, and medical records requests.

  • Respond to calls and messages professionally and promptly.

  • Create accurate electronic encounters for every relevant patient interaction.

  • Follow up consistently on incomplete, pending, or time-sensitive requests.

  • Protect patient privacy and comply with all confidentiality requirements.

  • Escalate clinical questions, urgent concerns, and exceptions to the appropriate team member.

  • Provide dependable administrative support to help the neurology facility operate efficiently.

raw.description:
Director of Sales – Nursing Education

UWorld is seeking a high-impact Director of Sales to lead and grow our Nursing Education sales organization across the Western United States. This is a full-time sales leadership and coaching position responsible for managing, developing, and motivating a team of Nursing Account Executives while driving consistent revenue growth across the region.

The Director will serve as a strategic leader for the Western region, partnering closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional teams to expand UWorld's presence within nursing programs and institutions.

We are looking for a dedicated sales leader who thrives on developing people, driving accountability, building strong sales processes, and creating a high-performance culture.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading B2B sales teams, preferably within nursing education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, or a related industry, and understands how to sell solutions that improve student outcomes and help nursing programs prepare students for high-stakes licensure examinations.

What You'll Own

Regional Revenue Growth

  • Lead the sales strategy and revenue performance for UWorld's Nursing Education business across the Western United States.
  • Develop and execute regional sales strategies designed to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
  • Drive new institutional business across nursing schools, colleges, universities, and other healthcare education organizations.
  • Develop strategies to expand UWorld's footprint within existing nursing programs and institutional partners.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and areas for growth throughout the Western region.
  • Establish a predictable, scalable pipeline aligned with nursing program purchasing cycles and academic calendars.
  • Partner with senior sales leadership to develop regional goals, forecasts, and growth plans.

Sales Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Nursing Account Executives across the Western United States.
  • Establish clear expectations around revenue performance, pipeline generation, activity, customer engagement, and professional development.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, forecast meetings, and performance discussions.
  • Provide ongoing coaching focused on discovery, consultative selling, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and account expansion.
  • Listen to and evaluate sales calls using tools such as Gong to provide actionable coaching and development.
  • Create individualized development plans to strengthen each representative's skills and performance.
  • Identify high performers and develop them for increased responsibility and career growth.
  • Address performance issues quickly and effectively while maintaining a supportive, accountable environment.
  • Foster a collaborative, competitive, and results-oriented sales culture.
  • Partner with Recruiting and Sales Leadership to attract, interview, onboard, and retain high-performing sales talent.

Nursing Education Market Development

  • Develop a deep understanding of the nursing education market, including nursing schools, faculty, program directors, deans, and other institutional decision-makers.
  • Help the sales team understand the unique challenges facing nursing programs, including NCLEX preparation, student outcomes, retention, licensure success, and program performance.
  • Develop territory strategies to maximize market coverage and sales opportunities across the Western United States.
  • Identify opportunities to expand UWorld's relationships across nursing programs, departments, and institutions.
  • Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding customer needs, competitive activity, market trends, and product opportunities.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource to the sales team on nursing education trends and institutional buying behavior.

Sales Process & Operational Excellence

  • Establish and maintain a disciplined sales process across the Western sales organization.
  • Own regional pipeline health, sales forecasting, and revenue predictability.
  • Review pipeline regularly with Account Executives and provide coaching to improve opportunity progression and conversion.
  • Leverage Salesforce and Gong to monitor performance, evaluate pipeline quality, and identify coaching opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate CRM utilization, opportunity management, and forecasting.
  • Analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs that drive sales productivity and revenue growth.
  • Hold the team accountable for meeting and exceeding established sales goals.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve sales processes, tools, and methodologies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Marketing to develop regional demand-generation strategies and campaigns.
  • Collaborate with Product and Product Marketing to provide market intelligence and customer feedback.
  • Partner with Customer Success to support customer retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction.
  • Work closely with Sales Leadership to ensure alignment on national strategy, goals, and priorities.
  • Represent the voice of the Nursing Education sales organization in cross-functional meetings and strategic initiatives.
  • Help ensure the sales team has the messaging, tools, training, and resources needed to successfully engage nursing education customers.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–12+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 5 years of successful sales leadership experience.
  • Proven success managing and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience selling into nursing education, higher education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, SaaS, or a related industry.
  • Strong understanding of the nursing education ecosystem and the needs of nursing schools, faculty, and academic leadership is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding team revenue targets.
  • Experience managing geographically dispersed sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach sales representatives in consultative, value-based selling.
  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting skills.
  • Experience using CRM and sales intelligence platforms such as Salesforce and Gong.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to travel throughout the Western United States as needed.

What Sets You Apart

  • You know how to build high-performing teams. You know how to establish expectations, create accountability, identify potential, and develop people into stronger sales professionals.
  • You are data-driven. You know how to use pipeline data, activity metrics, conversion rates, forecasting, and CRM insights to identify problems and improve performance.
  • You are an exceptional communicator. You can confidently communicate with Account Executives, sales leadership, customers, and executive stakeholders.
  • You lead with urgency and accountability. You set a high bar, move quickly, and create a culture where people understand what is expected and are motivated to achieve it.
  • You are comfortable in a growth environment. You enjoy building processes, developing people, and creating structure while the business continues to evolve.

Geographic Scope

This position will lead UWorld's Western United States Nursing Sales organization.

The Director may be based anywhere within the Western region and will work remotely, with regular travel throughout the territory to support the sales team, meet with customers, attend industry events, and participate in company meetings.

Candidates should be comfortable managing a geographically dispersed team and traveling as needed throughout the region.

Why UWorld?

At UWorld, you'll have the opportunity to lead a team that is helping shape the future of nursing education and student success. Our products are trusted by students and educators around the world, and our Nursing Education business represents an exciting opportunity for continued growth.

As Director of Sales, you'll have a meaningful leadership role in expanding UWorld's impact across nursing programs while building and developing a high-performing sales organization. You'll work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where leadership, accountability, innovation, and results are valued.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with 5% employer matching
  • On-site and virtual group fitness classes
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Supportive, collaborative work environment
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

At UWorld, we believe strength is derived from the talents, ideas, and experiences of a diverse workforce. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other protected class. UWorld is proud to be an equal opportunity employer providing a drug-free workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About the team

The Senior Specialist, Software Engineering, Back End designs, builds, and operates scalable, reliable backend services and platforms that power Zillow’s consumer and partner experiences. This role leads complex server-side development, improves system performance and resiliency, and collaborates closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to support millions of users and enable developer productivity across multiple brands.

We leverage technology best suited for each use case, however, our teams typically use the following tech:
Python, Java, NodeJS, and Go for our APIs and services
A range of persistence strategies including relational and non-relational databases

About the role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you’ll lead the delivery and ongoing support of projects from end-to-end. In addition, you will:

  • Contribute to the design of new features.

  • Review the code of your peers

  • Advocate for standard methodologies

  • Facilitate engineering discussions

  • Mentor junior engineers

  • Participate in an inclusive, energetic and highly multi-functional team.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

Wondering if we're the right team for you? You'll excel in this team if you thrive on autonomy, seek out persistent problems, implement effective solutions quickly, and you are:

  • Bringing 5+ years of software development experience with Java, Python, NodeJS, and Go for APIs and services.

  • Experienced in a range of persistence strategies including relational and non-relational databases.

  • Fluent in English and Spanish (both written and spoken).

  • Must be authorized to work in Mexico.

  • Highly skilled with multiple modern development technologies used to design, deliver, debug, and maintain front-end user interfaces and back-end software systems.

  • Recognized as a technical leader on your team for several years and have an impact beyond your team.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and willingness to work across the stack

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, including S3, ec2, IAM, EKS, and others.

  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, observability, and operational excellence

  • Track record of partnering effectively with multiple engineering teams to deliver shared infrastructure

  • Passionate about setting standard methodologies and raising the bar for systems design, testing, code quality, and maintainability - not only for the team but for the entire engineering organization!

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

raw.excerpt: Who are we?  Hi!  👋 We are Ravelin!  We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems.
raw.description:
Who are we?
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.
If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.
The Team

You will be joining the Detection team, a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.

The Role

We are currently looking for an Engineering Manager to line manage ML engineers and drive innovation across our suite of fraud detection products. You’ll work closely with data scientists, product, engineering and our operations teams to develop ML models and ML products. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures.
You will hire, coach and develop a talented machine learning team to deliver on the ML product and platform roadmap. You are in your element working with people. You’ll partner closely with senior members of Detection to discover new avenues for ML product innovation. From time to time, you’re excited to even do some software or model development yourself.

The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job – and understand why both are important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a key leader in establishing excellence within machine learning engineering and across the detection team
  • Line manage a team of machine learning engineers - providing coaching and guidance in support of the ongoing development and growth of your team
  • Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure we make the right ML product decisions
  • Investigate model performance issues
  • Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as an engineering manager, managing at least 3 people
  • You are a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with data science, engineering, product, client operations teams and with senior leadership
  • You know how to manage and retain talented engineers from a diverse range of backgrounds and personalities. You can handle difficult management situations with tact, empathy and support
  • You have significant experience building and deploying ML models using the Python data stack
  • Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect, Kubeflow, Argo, etc.
  • You understand software engineering best practices (version control, unit tests, code reviews, CI/CD) and how they apply to machine learning engineering
  • Comfortable spending 30-40% of your time hands-on in the codebase and adapting your technical involvement based on the roadmap

Nice to haves
  • Pytorch or Tensorflow deep learning experience
  • Experience with Go, C++, Java or another systems language
  • Experience using dbt

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support.
  • Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind.
  • £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more.
  • Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you.
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you.
  • Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them.
  • Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program.
  • Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact.
  • Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week, on us!
  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active.
  • BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk.
  • Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget.

*Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.​*

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.

  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.

Nice-to-have:

  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.

What we can offer you

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Connecticut to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Connecticut: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Connecticut = $65,000 - $88,000
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

How you communicate and connect with people.

How you present yourself professionally.

Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Sourcing Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

At Janus, we believe in a world where healthcare functions efficiently. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of administrative workers and fundamentally change the way work is done. Our employees are our greatest asset, and we are passionate about creating strong culture with deep purpose. We are entrepreneurial and focused, yet humble, empathetic and inclusive. We value the individual and tackle problems as a team. The best idea wins, and teams celebrate together.

Summary

We are seeking a motivated and analytically driven Business Analyst with a strong foundation in healthcare revenue cycle management to join our Prior Authorization and Enriched Claim Status Automation Product Team. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers to analyze complex datasets, identify growth opportunities, and drive the evolution of our automation solutions. Your work will be instrumental in delivering products that streamline revenue cycle operations and create measurable value for our healthcare clients. The ideal candidate brings 1-3 years of hands-on experience in healthcare revenue cycle environments, with demonstrated knowledge of prior authorization, admission notification workflows, and claim status processes from both provider and payer perspectives.   • Document and map complex healthcare workflows and identify pain points and automation opportunities

Janus reserves the right to make changes and/or assign additional responsibilities of a role within reason at any time, with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience working with prior authorization and admission notification workflow and claim status processes on the provider and payer sides
  • Experience working with provider organizations, EHR systems, and RCM platforms; familiarity with EPIC is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with AI applications, Payer Guidelines, and Clinical Documentation initiatives

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities

This role does occasionally require domestic travel. These travel expectations will be communicated by the department manager or executive. Janus is committed to providing as much flexibility and advanced notice as possible related to scheduling travel.

Physical Demands

This job is operated in a professional remote or in-office environment. This job uses standard office equipment. This job is largely a sedentary role; however, the employee has the flexibility to move as needed. Constantly operates a computer, phone, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment. The employee frequently communicates with internal and/or external people. Must be able to exchange accurate information in a timely manner. Must be able to recognize objects from short and long distances.

About the Role

We're seeking a detail-oriented Intake Specialist / Insurance Authorizations professional to join a compassionate, fast-paced psychiatric practice serving children, adolescents, and adults. This practice offers a full range of psychiatric care under one roof — including NeuroStar TMS therapy for treatment-resistant depression — and this role plays a key part in making sure patients get to treatment without unnecessary delays.

You'll be the first voice many patients hear, gathering the information needed to get them scheduled and authorized for care — with a strong focus on NeuroStar TMS insurance authorizations, one of the most detail-intensive parts of this practice's workflow. NeuroStar authorizations typically require documenting prior antidepressant trials and medical necessity criteria before a payer will approve treatment, and much of that documentation and tracking runs through TrakStar, NeuroStar's dedicated patient data management portal.

What You'll Do

Patient Intake

  • Speak directly with new and existing patients by phone to gather and accurately document demographic information, medical history, insurance details, reason for visit, and other required intake information prior to evaluation
  • Prepare and set up patient charts prior to evaluations, ensuring all necessary information and documentation is complete and accurate

Insurance Authorizations & Verification

  • Manage insurance authorizations and verification, including working within insurance portals and payer platforms
  • Handle NeuroStar TMS-specific authorizations, including documenting medical necessity criteria (e.g., prior antidepressant trials) required by most payers
  • Track and manage TMS-related patient data and authorization documentation within TrakStar

Scheduling & Patient Communication

  • Schedule new patient evaluations, follow-up appointments, and patient recall
  • Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls (150–250 calls per day) with a professional, patient-focused approach

Administrative Support

  • Collect copays and process patient payments
  • Process prescription refill requests

Requirements

Required Qualifications

    • Minimum of 2 years of medical experience, preferably in psychiatry, behavioral health, or mental health
    • Experience with TMS therapy is highly preferred, given this role's strong focus on TMS insurance authorizations
    • Strong experience with insurance authorizations and verification, including working with insurance portals and payer platforms
    • Experience with NeuroStar and/or TrakStar is strongly preferred — direct familiarity with NeuroStar's authorization requirements and the TrakStar portal is a significant advantage for this role
    • Comfortable managing a high volume of calls while staying professional and patient-focused
    • Experience scheduling new patient evaluations, follow-up appointments, and patient recall

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LICSW) in Minnesota to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Minnesota: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Minnesota = $62,000 - $82,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere

Territory Manager – United States

Location: Remote – United States

BusPas is transforming how transit agencies, city departments, and public safety organizations manage mobility, curb operations, passenger information, and transportation infrastructure.

We are seeking a highly motivated Territory Manager to drive business growth across the United States. This is a national sales role focused on developing new opportunities, building executive relationships, and helping agencies improve transportation operations, safety, accessibility, and customer experience through innovative technology solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Develop new business opportunities with transit agencies, city DOTs, public works departments, law enforcement agencies, airports, and other public-sector organizations.
  • Build relationships with executive, operational, and technical decision-makers.
  • Manage opportunities from prospecting through contract award.
  • Conduct customer meetings, demonstrations, presentations, and industry outreach activities.
  • Represent BusPas at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support proposals, deployments, and customer success.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and account activity within the company CRM.

What We're Looking For

  • Hunter mentality with a proven track record of creating opportunities and winning new business.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience selling into government, transportation, public safety, mobility, infrastructure, smart city, or related markets is preferred.
  • Ability to navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel throughout the United States.

What Success Looks Like

  • Building a qualified pipeline of new opportunities.
  • Establishing relationships with key decision-makers across assigned markets.
  • Creating and advancing opportunities through the sales cycle.
  • Achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Contributing to the growth and expansion of BusPas across North America.

Why Join BusPas

  • High-growth transportation technology company.
  • Opportunity to make a measurable impact on mobility, safety, and accessibility.
  • Direct access to executive leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial and collaborative work environment.
  • Competitive compensation package with uncapped commission and performance incentives.

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  1. Resume/CV
  2. Cover Letter (maximum one page)
  3. Response to the following question (250 words maximum):

"Describe a business opportunity that you personally developed from scratch. What actions did you take, and what was the outcome?"

Le français suit

NATIONAL BOARD OF TRUSTEES (2 VOLUNTEER POSITIONS)

POSITION TYPE: Volunteer. Estimated commitment of approximately 4-8 hours per month, including meeting preparation and committee participation.

LOCATION: Flexible, Canada (Primarily remote with 1-2 in-person meetings annually).

POSTING DATE: March 18, 2026

DEADLINE: Open until positions are filled

START DATE: September 2026

The Organization

Canadian Parks and Wilderness Society (CPAWS) is Canada’s only national charity dedicated to protecting public land, freshwater and ocean, with a strong presence across the country. For more than 60 years, CPAWS has been a trusted leader in conservation — grounded in science, advocacy, local knowledge and collaboration — working to address the dual crises of biodiversity loss and climate change.

CPAWS advances the long-term protection of ecologically and culturally significant landscapes and waters, in ways that respect the sovereignty and leadership of Indigenous Nations. We achieve our mission through evidence-based advocacy, public engagement and strong partnerships.

Our vision is bold: permanently protect at least half of Canada’s land, freshwater and ocean to sustain nature and people for generations to come.

Operating on the unceded and unsurrendered lands of the Anishinabe Algonquin Nation, CPAWS works across treaty and unceded territories nationwide. We are committed to justice, equity, diversity and inclusion, and to fostering a safe and welcoming environment for people from diverse backgrounds.

The Role

CPAWS’ National Board of Trustees provides strategic governance oversight rather than operational management. Day-to-day leadership is the responsibility of the National Executive Director and staff. The Board works in partnership with this national team to:

  • Set long-term strategic direction
  • Ensure fiduciary oversight and financial sustainability
  • Monitor organizational performance and risk
  • Oversee and evaluate the National Executive Director
  • Ensure legal, ethical, and policy compliance
  • Safeguard mission alignment and long-term impact

The Opportunity

CPAWS is seeking two new Trustees with the following profiles to join its National Board:

Senior Executive Leader

A current or former CEO, President, Executive Director, or C-suite executive who has led a large, complex, multi-regional or national organization.

Ideal experience includes:

  • Leading growth, transformation, or strategic renewal
  • Oversight of multi-million dollar budgets and enterprise risk
  • Strong board–management partnership experience
  • Public policy, government relations, and/or national stakeholder engagement

Senior Fundraising / Development Leader

A senior development executive with demonstrated success in relationship-building with major donors, foundations and corporate partners.

Ideal experience includes:

  • Major gifts and donor strategy
  • Campaign leadership (capital, endowment, or comprehensive campaigns)
  • Corporate and foundation partnerships
  • Revenue diversification and philanthropic growth strategy (building capacity on the board)
  • Engaging boards in fundraising

Core Assets for Both Positions

  • Commitment to CPAWS’ mission and conservation outcomes
  • Governance experience (non-profit or corporate board experience preferred)
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Commitment to diversity and Indigenous reconciliation

Application Submission

We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including applicants from diverse cultures, racialized communities, abilities, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, and others who contribute to equitable representation and diverse perspectives.

We are committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process. Please contact if you require accommodation at any stage.

Please apply submitting a cover letter and résumé combined into a single PDF titled: “LAST NAME_Board of Trustees”.

We thank all candidates for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

CONSEIL D’ADMINISTRATION NATIONAL (2 POSTES DE BÉNÉVOLAT )

TYPE DE POSTE : Bénévole. Engagement d’environ 4 à 8 heures par mois, y compris la préparation des réunions et la participation aux comités.

LIEU : Flexible, Canada (principalement à distance avec 1 à 2 réunions en présentiel par an).

DATE DE PUBLICATION : 18 mars 2026

DATE LIMITE : jusqu’à ce que les postes soient pourvus

DATE DE DÉBUT : Septembre 2026

L’organisation

La Société pour la nature et les parcs du Canada (SNAP CANADA) est le seul organisme caritatif national du Canada dédié à la protection de nos terres publiques, de nos eaux douces et de nos océans, en mettant à profit sa forte présence à travers le pays. Depuis plus de 60 ans, la SNAP CANADA est un chef de file reconnu dans le domaine de la conservation. Notre travail axé sur la science, la sensibilisation, les connaissances locales et la collaboration cherche à contrer la double crise de la perte de biodiversité et du changement climatique.

La SNAP CANADA œuvre à la protection à long terme des terres et des eaux d’importance écologique et culturelle. En travaillant dans le respect de la souveraineté et du leadership des Nations autochtones, nous accomplissons notre mission grâce à un plaidoyer fondé sur des données probantes, à la mobilisation du public et à des partenariats solides.

Notre vision est ambitieuse : protéger de façon permanente au moins la moitié des terres, des eaux douces et des océans du Canada afin d’assurer la survie de la nature et des être humains pour les générations à venir.

Établie sur les terres non cédées et non abandonnées de la Nation algonquine Anishinabe, la SNAP CANADA travaille sur les territoires visés par des traités et non cédés à l’échelle nationale. Nous sommes engagés en faveur de la justice, de l’équité, de la diversité et de l’inclusion, et nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement sûr et accueillant pour les personnes issues de divers horizons.

Le rôle

Le conseil d’administration national de la SNAP CANADA assure la supervision stratégique plutôt que la gestion opérationnelle. La direction des activités quotidiennes relève de la responsabilité du/de la directeur·ice général·e national·e et du personnel. Le conseil d’administration travaille en partenariat avec cette équipe nationale pour :

  • Établir l’orientation stratégique à long terme
  • Assurer la supervision fiduciaire et la viabilité financière
  • Surveiller la performance et les risques de l’organisation
    • Superviser et évaluer le·a directeur·ice général·e national·e
  • Garantir la conformité juridique, éthique et réglementaire
  • Garantir l’alignement sur la mission et l’impact à long terme

L’opportunité

La SNAP CANADA cherche à recruter deux nouvelles personnes présentant les profils suivants pour siéger à son conseil d’administration national:

Cadre supérieur

Une personne qui occupe ou a occupé un poste de PDG, de président, de directeur général ou de cadre supérieur au sein d’une grande organisation complexe et de portée multirégionale ou nationale.

L’expérience idéale comprend :

  • La conduite de projets de croissance, de transformation ou de réorientation stratégique
  • La supervision de budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars et la gestion des risques d’entreprise
  • Une solide expérience en matière de collaboration entre le conseil d’administration et la direction
  • Les politiques publiques, les relations gouvernementales et/ou la mobilisation des parties prenantes au niveau national

Responsable principal de la collecte de fonds/du développement

Une personne qui occupe ou a occupé un poste de cadre supérieur en développement et qui a fait ses preuves dans l’établissement de relations avec d’importants donateurs, des fondations et des entreprises partenaires.

L’expérience idéale comprend :

  • La stratégie en matière de dons majeurs et de relations avec les donateurs
  • La direction de campagnes (campagnes de capitalisation, de dotation ou globales)
  • La gestion de partenariats avec les entreprises et les fondations
  • La stratégie en matière de diversification des revenus et de croissance philanthropique (renforcement des capacités au sein du conseil d’administration)
  • La participation des conseils d’administration dans la collecte de fonds

Compétences essentielles pour les deux postes

  • Adhésion à la mission de la SNAP CANADA et à ses objectifs de conservation
  • Expérience en matière de gouvernance (idéalement au sein d’un conseil d’administration d’une organisation à but non lucratif ou d’une entreprise)
  • Réflexion stratégique et bon jugement
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en établissement de relations
  • Engagement envers la diversité et la réconciliation avec les peuples autochtones

Soumission des candidatures

Nous encourageons toutes les personnes qualifiées à postuler, indépendamment de leur origine culturelle, de leur appartenance à une communauté racialisée, de leurs capacités physiques, de leur orientations sexuelle, de leur identité ou expression de genre, ainsi que toute autre personne susceptible de contribuer à une représentation équitable et à la diversité des perspectives.

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus de recrutement inclusif et sans obstacle. Veuillez contacter si vous avez besoin d’aménagements à n’importe quelle étape.

Veuillez postuler en joignant une lettre de motivation et un CV regroupés dans un seul fichier PDF intitulé : « NOM DE FAMILLE_Conseil d’administration »

Nous remercions toutes les personnes qui auront soumis une candidature. Seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées. Les candidatures seront examinées au fur et à mesure.

Salary: Volunteer role / Bénévolat.

Elementary Physical Education - College Lesson Editor

We are seeking detail‑oriented Elementary Physical Education Experts to review and revise college-level lessons. You will check to confirm the accuracy and clarity of lessons to ensure our content is a great resource for students.

This is a remote contractor role. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes.

All work is paid hourly.

Job Description:


The subject-matter expert will carefully perform accuracy checks on provided college-level lessons. Minor edits may be required if the lesson is inaccurate in any way, and the expert must be capable of confirming that lessons are coherent and helpful for our users.

What You’ll Do

- Follow internal documentation to improve content accuracy and quality of provided lessons
- Review and approve college-level lessons in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Verify content is accurate, on-level, and appropriate for the related course

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Subject-matter expertise in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Ability to work independently and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications

- A bachelor’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
- 3-5 years of teaching experience in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
College teaching experience in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
Experience with content management systems

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

Job title: Marketing Automation & CRM Operations Manager
Function: Marketing Team
Salary: INR1000000-1300000
Location: India (remote)

Overview
This role is responsible for managing and optimising lead management, customer journeys, and performance reporting. The post holder will be responsible for the configuration, integration, and optimisation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Click Dimensions, ensuring both systems meet business requirements and deliver measurable marketing impact

Working closely with marketing, sales, and insights teams, the Marketing Automation Manager will design automated nurture journeys, improve CRM processes, and connect reporting across multiple data sources using Looker Studio and Power BI. The role also involves maintaining and configuring integrations between platforms such as Zapier, WhatsApp Business, and advertising channels, ensuring data accuracy and campaign visibility across online and offline sources. On occasion, the holder will be expected to be a business lead on joint projects with the Technology team, especially in terms of providing business requirements for system development.

This position bridges marketing, data, and technology ensuring every prospect and customer interaction is seamless, insight-driven, and contributes to business growth.

Key responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated marketing journeys in ClickDimensions, including email campaigns, lead scoring, event triggers, and nurture workflows.
  • Oversee the day-to-day management and optimisation of commercial pipeline processes on the CRM (lead capture, qualification inputs, campaign attribution) ensuring data integrity, efficient lead tracking, and smooth integration with other systems.
  • Map and manage end-to-end customer journeys, from enquiry through to conversion and retention.
  • Design and implement operational CRM strategies that enhance engagement, conversion, and overall customer experience.
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to streamline lead qualification, follow-up, and reporting processes.
  • Manage and maintain integrations with tools such as ClickDimensions, Zapier, and WhatsApp Business, ensuring consistent and reliable data flow.
  • Configure and maintain workflows, automations, dashboards, and custom fields within Dynamics to support operational needs.[PS3]
  • Build/maintain marketing dashboards and request schema changes via change control.
  • Manage audience segmentation and personalisation to deliver relevant and timely communications across email, SMS, and WhatsApp Business.
  • Work with the creative and content teams to produce engaging and effective campaign templates.
  • Conduct A/B testing and analyse engagement metrics to continuously optimise campaigns.
  • Ensure seamless integration and data synchronisation between ClickDimensions and Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Build and maintain dashboards in Looker Studio and Power BI, integrating CRM data with online and offline advertising performance.
  • Connect and visualise data from multiple sources, including Microsoft Dynamics, ClickDimensions, and advertising platforms (e.g. Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn).
  • Monitor campaign performance, conversion rates, and lead source attribution to provide actionable insights.
  • Support the marketing and leadership teams with regular performance reports and recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance data connections and streamline marketing reporting processes.
  • Stay informed on new features, tools, and automation best practices to continuously improve performance.
  • Deliver training and support to team members on CRM and marketing automation tools.
  • Main POC for marketing-tool issues (ClickDimensions, forms, Zapier); escalate CRM platform issues to the CRM Product/Power Platform team.
  • Maintain compliance with GDPR and internal data management policies.

Skills and experience
Essential:
  • Proven experience using Dynamics 365 for marketing operations, writing requirements for automation/integrations, and collaborating with delivery teams.
  • Hands-on experience using Click Dimensions for marketing automation and lead nurturing.
  • Strong understanding of CRM data structures and automation processes.
  • Experience connecting data sources and building reports in Looker Studio and/or Power BI.
  • Experience using Zapier or similar RPA tools to connect marketing and CRM systems.
  • Familiarity with WhatsApp Business for customer communication and automation.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and deliver actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
  • Strong understanding of GDPR and marketing data compliance.
Desirable:
  • Experience with campaign attribution, UTM tracking, or paid media reporting.
  • Exposure to both online and offline marketing data environments.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, data-driven marketing or digital team.
Managing and optimising the marketing use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and ClickDimensions, designing journeys, improving lead handling, and connecting campaign data, in partnership with the CRM Product/Power Platform team.

Oversee the marketing processes within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (lead capture, qualification inputs, campaign attribution).

Define requirements for automations and data; CRM team builds & releases in Power Automate. Build/maintain marketing dashboards and request schema changes via change control.

raw.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.

raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

Our Games Studio is at the heart of this mission, dedicated to building world class iCasino games that thrill players and define the next generation of online casino entertainment. We’re now looking for a Senior Graphic Artist to join our team creating the next generation of games including slots, Card & Table, Arcade games, and other game types of original and brand-led games for the future. This is a chance to define the artistic standard and inspire the creative heartbeat of the studio games with vision. You'll bring life to our ideas and create unforgettable moments for millions of players.

What’s the position?

We’re looking for a super talented Senior Graphic Artist - Studio Slots, you’ll work with our Art Director developing the creative art and concepts of our in-house iCasino games. You will work from concept art and mood boards to production and polish—ensuring a consistent, high-quality look across everything we build. You’ll work hands-on and high-level, working with our Product Managers/Producers and partnering closely with the game development teams, math, engineering, and external contributors to ensure each game looks stunning, plays smoothly, and reflects our player-first values.

This is an important role for someone with both creative mastery and production chops—someone who leads by example, understands how games get made, and thrives in a fast-moving, collaborative studio environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Game Art Vision: Working with the Art Director to define and direct the visual identity of each game, from game concept to final polish—through clear creative direction and compelling concept art.

  • Create Concept Art: Develop characters, environments, UI themes, and mood boards to establish visual direction, especially for internal & external development partners.

  • Work with Internal & External Art Teams: Produce key assets and style guides to deliver high-quality, on-game visuals.

  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work closely with product, design, math, and engineering to bring ideas to life within creative and technical constraints.

  • Prototype & Iterate: Build visual prototypes and motion tests to refine ideas and solve presentation challenges early.

  • Production: Manage timelines, asset delivery, and feedback loops to ensure quality and alignment throughout the art pipeline working with other lead team members.

  • Design Systems: Maintain scalable visual frameworks and reusable assets to support speed and consistency across titles.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a results-driven senior artist who excels in transforming creative game concepts into market-leading casino slot and other games. We are looking for a highly creative and experienced artist who understands what makes a great slot feel unforgettable. You’ll have the vision, technical depth, and production experience to create both hands-on and cross-functional creative efforts in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Deep experience in creating game art, and concepts for real-money games including slots, Card & table, and Arcade games, with multiple shipped titles at a AAA-level quality.

  • Portfolio link showing games created should be provided when applying.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating original game art including concepting, asset design, UI/UX, and animation pipelines.

  • 5+ years of experience in casino game development, art production, and asset delivery.

  • Mastery of 2D/3D art tools (e.g., Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Spine, Unity/Unreal) and fluency in both vector and bitmap workflows.

  • Ability to work across diverse art styles, from photorealistic to stylized or branded IPs, while respecting artistic integrity and licensing needs.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills—you can pitch creative ideas to execs and explain workflows to developers with equal ease.

  • A highly collaborative, fast-moving mindset—you’re comfortable working remotely, juggling multiple projects, and adapting quickly to feedback.

  • Bonus points for motion graphics, animation, video editing experience, and for prototyping or scripting experience that helps bring designs to life.

  • A sense of humor and a passion for building compelling, high-quality fun games and player experiences.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Flexible work from home or office hours

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer)

  • Streamline financial reporting processes through Excel-based improvements and structured templates
  • Support finance system enhancements as needed

  • Partner with department heads to align budgets with business priorities
  • Provide financial guidance to improve cost efficiency and margin performance
  • Support leadership in decision-making through data-driven insights

  • Experience in a high-growth or subscription/recurring revenue environment

  • Strong financial modeling skills in Excel, including budgeting, forecasting, and scenario modeling
  • Experience preparing management- or executive-level reports, board reporting
  • Understanding of subscription revenue metrics such as ARR, MRR, and revenue forecasting
  • Experience working with CRM (e.g., Salesforce) preferred
  • Experience with accounting systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or similar)
  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently in a lean, high-accountability environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner with senior stakeholders

Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven ownership of budgeting and forecasting cycles
  • Experience building and maintaining financial models to support business planning
  • Exposure to executive or board reporting
  • Working knowledge of SaaS revenue dynamics
  • Ability to balance technical financial modeling with strategic business support
  • Experience operating in a lean team structure
