Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.

This posting is for a position within the Experience unit at Genpact. Experience is Genpact’s capability for designing and improving the platforms, interactions and journeys employees and customers use every day. With deep expertise across leading platforms like Adobe, Microsoft, Sitecore, and Optimizely, we unite strategy, human-centered design, engineering and AI inside core enterprise systems, so experiences don’t just look better, they perform better, drive adoption and turn advanced technology into measurable business outcomes at scale.

Our Commitment to YOU!

No matter who you are, where you come from, who you love, what you believe, or what you get excited about, we bring people together to make phenomenal work. That’s what makes us Genpact!

Why This Role Matters

This role sits at the intersection of technology leadership, client consulting, delivery execution, and business growth. The successful architect will shape Optimizely solution strategy, guide engineering teams, support business development pursuits, and help grow capabilities across Optimizely and adjacent composable DXP platforms.

What You’ll Be Doing and the Impact You’ll Make

TheOptimizelySolution Architect will serve as the technical leader responsible for defining, designing, and delivering enterprise-grade digital experience platforms for clients. This role combines strategic architecture leadership, client consulting, hands-on technical contribution, and team mentorship to ensure successful project delivery and long-term client success. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in theOptimizelyecosystem while maintaining a willingness to expand into complementary platforms such asSitecore.

  • Define end-to-end solution architectures across content management, personalization, search, integrations, marketing technology, and cloud platforms.
  • Lead the design of modern Optimizely implementations including CMS 12/13, CMS SaaS, Optimizely DXP, Optimizely Graph, Search & Navigation, Content Marketing Platform (CMP), Optimizely Data Platform (ODP), Web Experimentation, Feature Experimentation, Personalization, Content Recommendations, Product Recommendations, Optimizely Connect Platform, Opti ID, and composable DXP architectures.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Marketing, IT, and executive leadership stakeholders.
  • Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions, technical assessments, and solution strategy discussions.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, code review, and governance for development teams.
  • Remain hands-on by contributing to proof-of-concepts, integrations, technical spikes, and critical development efforts.
  • Design and implement integrations using APIs, GraphQL, middleware platforms, and cloud-native services.
  • Partner with sales and account teams during pursuits and strategic client engagements.
  • Lead requirements synthesis, solution definition, estimates, staffing plans, assumptions, and implementation approaches.
  • Support RFP responses, proposal creation, and executive proposal presentations.

What We’d like to See

  • 8+ years delivering enterprise digital platforms usingOptimizelyand Microsoft technologies.
  • 5+ years serving as a Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or similar leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with the Optimizely ecosystem, including CMS 12/13, CMS SaaS, Optimizely DXP, Optimizely Graph, Search & Navigation, Content Marketing Platform (CMP), Optimizely Data Platform (ODP), Web Experimentation, Feature Experimentation, Personalization, Content Recommendations, Product Recommendations, Optimizely Connect Platform, Opti ID, headless delivery models, API-first integrations, and composable DXP architecture patterns.
  • Strong experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, API development, and modern architecture principles.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams and guiding solution delivery.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience integrating CRM, DAM, CDP, ERP, marketing automation, and custom business platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Azure, cloud-native architectures, DevOps, and modern deployment practices.

Leadership & Consulting Skills

  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence technical and business decisions across organizations.
  • Strong consulting, solutioning, and requirements gathering experience.
  • Experience mentoring architects, leads, and developers.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic architecture responsibilities with hands-on execution.

Some Cool Extras

  • Optimizely developer, architect, or platform-related certifications, or Solution Architect certifications.
  • Experience with adjacent DXP platforms such as Sitecore XM/XP, XM Cloud/Sitecore AI, Content Hub, CDP, Personalize, Search, and composable Sitecore architecture patterns.
  • Experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Experience with Azure Container Apps, Kubernetes, Docker, or serverless platforms.
  • Consulting or agency experience supporting enterprise digital transformations.

Why Genpact?

  • Flexible PTO – If you need a day off or an extended vacation, take the time!
  • Hybrid work environment: Casual and open office or Remote…You choose!
  • Great insurance coverage (Multiple Options) and flexible spending accounts
  • 401K with Company Matching
  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend
  • Continuous Training, Certifications, and Learning Opportunities

EEO Statement

Genpact, is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation

raw.title: Client Manager
raw.excerpt: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management.
raw.description:
AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We are committed to making pharmacy benefits easy to understand, straightforward to access and always in the best interest of employers and the lives they impact. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizingstate-of-the-art technology.

Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always.

Position Summary:

The Client Manager serves as the primary day-to-day operational contact for assigned employer and health plan clients, ensuring a high level of service and support. Working within a cross-functional account team, this role collaborates closely with internal partners to deliver a seamless client experience. The position manages the operational aspects of client accounts, including benefit administration, plan changes, eligibility updates, implementations, and issue resolution. The Client Manager also provides clear guidance on pharmacy benefit matters and ensures client needs and commitments are effectively communicated and addressed. Additionally, the role identifies opportunities to improve benefit performance, enhance client satisfaction, and support long-term client success.

What you will do:

Client Support and Relationship Coordination:

  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned client accounts, supporting the Client Executive and broader account team in delivering exceptional service
  • Build positive working relationships with client contacts, including HR teams, benefits administrators, and consultants
  • Respond to client inquiries and requests promptly, ensuring questions are routed to the appropriate internal teams and followed through to resolution
  • Maintain accurate account records, client communications, and action items within Salesforce and other internal systems
  • Support client meetings by preparing agendas, tracking action items, and coordinating follow-up activities

Benefit Administration and Operational Support:

  • Assist with processing eligibility updates, benefit changes, plan configuration requests, and other routine account maintenance activities.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Eligibility, Billing, Clinical, and IT teams to ensure timely execution of client requests.
  • Support implementation activities, renewals, and benefit changes by tracking timelines and helping ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Validate information for accuracy and escalate discrepancies or issues as needed.

Reporting and Account Management Support:

  • Monitor account performance metrics, pharmacy spend, and utilization trends; surface insights and optimization opportunities to the Client Executive and Clinical Consultant
  • Prepare and contribute to quarterly business plans, financial performance summaries, and client-facing reporting packages
  • Identify cost-savings opportunities and operational efficiencies within assigned accounts and escalate upsell or growth opportunities to the Client Executive

Cross-Functional Coordination and Issue Resolution:

  • Triage and resolve client issues by coordinating across internal teams and communicating status clearly to clients throughout the resolution process
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues to the Director, Client Management or Client Executive as appropriate, with context and recommended resolution
  • Participate in regular account team meetings with the Client Executive, Clinical Consultant, and Patient Care Advocacy partners to align on client priorities and action items

Process, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement:

  • Follow established company policies, procedures, and compliance requirements in all client interactions and account activities.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of client requests, decisions, and completed work.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, client experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to build PBM, client management, and industry expertise.

What you need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered
  • 0-1 year of experience in account management, client success, or client-facing operations within a PBM, health plan, TPA, or managed-care environment
  • Healthcare experience required
  • Working knowledge of pharmacy benefit operations including claims processing, formulary management, eligibility, network configurations, and benefit plan design
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex pharmacy benefit information into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities with attention to detail and consistent follow-through
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and standard business tools (Microsoft Office, Teams)
  • Experience within a transparent, pass-through, or PBM-optimizer organization
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar healthcare CRM platforms
  • Experience supporting quarterly business reviews and client-facing financial reporting
  • Prior experience working in a pod or team-based account model

What you get:

  • To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes
  • To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business thrives
  • Competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits

Note:

AffirmedRx is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Remote employees are expected to maintain a professional work environment free of distractions to ensure optimal performance and collaboration.

raw.title: Associate Product Manager / Associate Game Producer - Casino Games
raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

Across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade games, we are creating differentiated experiences that combine proven player appeal, outstanding creative execution, innovative mechanics, and the quality expected from the Hard Rock brand. You will have the opportunity to help shape games from the earliest concepts through launch, working with our internal Studio team and external development partners to create content that becomes an important part of the Hard Rock Bet Casino experience.

What’s the position?

We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager / Associate Game Producer, Casino Games to help create the next generation of proprietary games for Hard Rock Bet Casino.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their casino gaming career who wants to develop across Product Management, Game Production, Game Design, Creative Development, and game performance.

Working closely with Senior Product Managers and Game Producers, you will help take games from concept through development, QA, certification, launch, and performance review.

Depending on Studio priorities and your experience, you may work across Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, or multiple game categories.

You will help coordinate internal teams, external game studios, artists, mathematicians, technical partners, QA, Compliance, and Release teams while learning how great casino games are designed, produced, launched, and optimized.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Full Game Lifecycle: Help manage casino games from early concept through design, development, QA, certification, launch, and post launch review.

  • Support Game Production: Maintain requirements, GDDs, development priorities, action items, game feedback, milestone plans, and production documentation.

  • Own Defined Game Workstreams: Take responsibility for specific features, smaller projects, game variants, or titles under the guidance of senior Studio leaders.

  • Contribute to Game Concepts: Research successful games, mechanics, themes, player behaviors, and industry trends to help identify new game opportunities.

  • Support Creative Development: Participate in reviews of gameplay, art, animation, audio, UI/UX, features, and overall game presentation.

  • Coordinate Development Partners: Work closely with external game studios and internal teams to track deliverables, feedback, decisions, and next steps.

  • Support Game Quality: Play and review games throughout development, identify issues, provide structured feedback, and help ensure games meet Studio quality standards.

  • Support Regulated Market Delivery: Help coordinate game documentation, testing, certification requirements, compliance feedback, and release readiness.

  • Track Game Performance: Work with Analytics, Casino Product, and senior Studio team members to understand how games perform after launch and identify learnings for future development.

  • Maintain Competitive Intelligence: Regularly play and analyze leading casino games and suppliers across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade categories.

  • Keep Projects Moving: Help maintain project trackers, timelines, decisions, risks, and dependencies while following up with stakeholders to keep delivery on schedule.

  • Champion the Player Experience: Bring curiosity, player empathy, and attention to detail to every game.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is passionate about casino games and wants to build a career creating them.

You are curious about why games work, not just whether they are fun. You enjoy understanding mechanics, math, features, art, player behavior, user experience, and what makes one game perform better than another.

You are organized, proactive, comfortable receiving feedback, and eager to learn from experienced game producers, developers, artists, mathematicians, and product leaders. You do not need to know everything on day one. You do need strong ownership, attention to detail, curiosity, and a genuine desire to build great games.

You will:

  • 3 years+ of experience in product management, game production, game development, casino content, gaming, or another relevant digital product environment.

  • A strong interest in casino games, including Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, social casino, mobile games, or related gaming categories.

  • Some understanding of the game or software development lifecycle from concept through testing and launch.

  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working with creative, technical, mathematical, and business teams.

  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to play, review, test, and critique games throughout development.

  • An analytical mindset with an interest in player behavior, game performance, market trends, and competitive intelligence.

  • Ability to translate feedback and ideas into clear requirements, actions, or documentation.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Figma, wireframing, analytics tools, game development tools, or similar platforms is a plus.

  • Experience with regulated iCasino, social casino, mobile gaming, game development studios, or casino operations is a plus.

  • A player first mindset, strong curiosity, creativity, and a desire to continually improve.

  • A sense of humor and genuine passion for games.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Flexible work from home or office hours

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to learn from experienced casino game leaders and development partners

  • Opportunity to help build proprietary Hard Rock casino games played by millions

  • Clear opportunity to grow into a Product Manager / Game Producer role as the Studio expands

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

raw.description:
Über Recare

Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie. Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen. Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter – und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen.

Das erwartet dich als unser Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data:

  • Arbeit mit Purpose – Deine Tätigkeit hat positiven Einfluss auf Patientinnen und Patienten, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen.

  • Unternehmenskultur – Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die eine hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Wir pflegen einen Umgang, der von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt ist, und streben gemeinsam nach unseren Zielen und erwarten das Gleiche von dir.

  • Flexibilität – Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten.

  • Edenred-Karte – die du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.

  • Zusatz-Urlaubstag – Damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst, hast du ihn frei.

Deine Rolle als Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data:

Als Teil unseres Revenue Operations Teams unterstützt du uns dabei, eine hohe Datenqualität in unseren zentralen Systemen sicherzustellen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für dich, wenn du erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Daten sammeln möchtest und verstehen willst, wie datengetriebene Unternehmen arbeiten. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung, lernst moderne Tools kennen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Revenue-Teams.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege, Bereinigung und Strukturierung von Daten in unserem CRM-System (Salesforce) und stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sowie konsistente Datensätze sicher.

  • Du bereitest Daten für Reports und Analysen (z. B. in Salesforce) auf und überprüfst diese vor der Nutzung auf Vollständigkeit und Qualität.

  • Du identifizierst Datenlücken, Inkonsistenzen und strukturelle Probleme und unterstützt bei deren Behebung.

  • Du wirkst an der Definition und Dokumentation von Datenstandards sowie Data-Hygiene-Prozessen mit.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Teams wie Sales, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen und unterstützt datengetriebene Prozesse im Arbeitsalltag.

Requirements

So stellen wir uns dich als unseren Working Student (m/w/d) CRM & Data vor:

  • Du bist aktuell in einem relevanten Studiengang immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Analytics).

  • Du bringst erste Erfahrungen mit CRM-Systemen mit (z. B. Salesforce)

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets (z. B. Filtern, Sortieren, einfache Formeln)

  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für strukturierte Daten (z. B. Tabellen, Felder, Datensätze)

  • Du interessierst dich für Daten und Analysen und bringst die nötige Sorgfalt sowie Konzentration für datenintensive Aufgaben mit

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Du kommunizierst klar und arbeitest gerne mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2)

Nice-to-haves - womit du uns zusätzlich überzeugst:

  • Grundkenntnisse in BI-Tools (z. B. Looker)

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Datenbereinigung oder Datenimporten

raw.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

deine mission bei ]init[

Du willst die digitale Verwaltung von morgen mitgestalten – dort, wo sie für Menschen unmittelbar spürbar wird? Als Professional Consultant (all genders) für digitale Verwaltungsprojekte im Fachbereich Migration & Inneres berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsvorhaben in einem gesellschaftlich und politisch hochrelevanten Umfeld. Du durchdringst komplexe fachliche und organisatorische Fragestellungen, entwickelst tragfähige Zielbilder und Lösungsansätze und bringst Fachlichkeit, Verwaltung und Technologie zusammen. Dabei endet Beratung für dich nicht beim Konzept: Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams begleitest du Lösungen von der ersten Fragestellung bis in die erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

das gibt es zu tun

  • Du berätst unsere Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung bei anspruchsvollen IT- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben mit besonderem Fokus auf Migration & Inneres sowie Themen der Inneren Sicherheit und gestaltest mit unseren Kund:innen gemeinsam die Weiterentwicklung von Verwaltungsprozessen und digitalen Services, hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und bereitest fachliche Entscheidungen strukturiert vor.
  • Du arbeitest dich tief in komplexe fachliche Zusammenhänge ein, analysierst fachliche, organisatorische und prozessuale Fragestellungen und entwickelst daraus Zielbilder, Handlungsoptionen und konkrete Empfehlungen.
  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops, Interviews und Abstimmungsformate, führst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen und begleitest Kund:innen und weitere Stakeholder durch Entscheidungs- und Veränderungsprozesse.
  • Du bringst Verwaltung, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen, strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Projekt- und Entwicklungsteams in tragfähige digitale Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Konzepte bis in die Praxis – von Analyse und Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption, Pilotierung und Tests bis zum Go-live – und behältst dabei Nutzer, Akzeptanz und die nachhaltige Verankerung der Lösungen im Blick.

das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kund:innen des Public Sectors im Kontext von IT-, Digitalisierungs- oder Transformationsvorhaben mit und hast bereits eigenständig Beratungsaufgaben oder fachliche Arbeitspakete verantwortet.
  • Du kannst dich schnell und fundiert in komplexe Fachthemen einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge analysieren und strukturieren sowie daraus belastbare Handlungsoptionen, Empfehlungen, Zielbilder und Konzepte ableiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bewegst dich kommunikativ sicher auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Kund:innen- und Projektorganisation.
  • Du fühlst dich nicht nur in der fachlichen Beratung wohl, sondern möchtest deine Konzepte gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams in die Umsetzung bringen und ihre Wirkung in der Praxis erleben.
  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsvorhaben der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu Migration, Inneres oder Innerer Sicherheit mit. Kenntnisse rund um OZG, EfA, FIM, Datenschutz oder IT-Service-Management sind ein Plus.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet idealerweise die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

werde teil des teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

raw.title: Sr. Ecommerce SEO Specialist
raw.excerpt: About Searchbloom Searchbloom is an established and growing company.
raw.description:
About Searchbloom

Searchbloom is an established and growing company. This provides you with the unique opportunity to share your expertise with exceptional digital marketers, make your mark in the organization, and create opportunities for future advancement.

Sr. SEO Specialist (eCommerce)

About the Role
We’re hiring a Senior SEO Specialist to lead strategy, identify high-impact opportunities, and serve as the organic growth lead across a portfolio of high-performing client accounts, with a primary focus on ecommerce partners. You’ll guide partners through SEO strategic roadmaps, execute detailed audits, manage technical prioritization, and drive measurable performance across large product catalogs, category driven architectures, and revenue focused initiatives.

In this role, you will own organic growth for ecommerce brands by improving product and category discoverability, managing indexation at scale, and aligning SEO strategy with merchandising, conversion, and lifetime value goals. You will collaborate closely with content, outreach, paid media, and development teams to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented in ways that support both rankings and revenue.

This is a full-time, remote position that reports to the Director of SEO.

Our SEO team is trusted to lead, not just support. This role is central to how we help partners grow.

Also known as: SEO Strategist, Technical SEO Manager, Organic Search Specialist

About Searchbloom
Searchbloom is an established and growing company. This provides you with the unique opportunity to share your expertise with exceptional digital marketers, make your mark in the organization, and create opportunities for future advancement.

Searchbloom is in search of an experienced SEO Specialist. Come join our team of digital marketers who work great together to do an amazing job for our partners, and play hard along the way. To fit in, you’ve got to be an advanced SEO with a real passion for organic search. We’re looking for people who stay on top of what’s really working and have strong opinions about the implications of strategic approaches. The majority of your workday will be spent identifying, documenting, and prioritizing SEO issues for clients.

Compensation
$75,000 – $90,000 annually, depending on experience, technical depth, and client management skills.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

Ecommerce SEO Expertise (Required)

  • Proven experience scaling SEO for ecommerce sites with hundreds to tens of thousands of SKUs
  • Proven client-facing experience in an agency environment
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
    • Advanced proficiency in using formulas, & data manipulation techniques to create meaningful, client-facing analysis through Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
  • Outstanding communication skills with the ability to influence multiple stakeholders
  • Deep knowledge of SEO tools: Ahrefs, Moz, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics
  • Experience implementing and validating ecommerce structured data, including Product, Review, Offer, and Breadcrumb schema
  • Hands-on experience optimizing category pages and product detail pages (PDPs) for search visibility and conversion support
  • Experience developing, managing, executing, and measuring SEO campaigns for medium-to-large brands and eCommerce websites
  • Strong understanding of page-level SEO, site architecture, technical audits, and structured data
  • Experience with AEO/ AI SEO strategies including featured snippet and AIO targeting, FAQ markup, entity optimization, and search intent mapping
  • Familiarity with basic HTML, CSS, PHP and JavaScript concepts
  • Experience supporting or collaborating on product feed optimization and feed management solutions that impact organic shopping visibility
  • Working knowledge of recent and ongoing algorithm changes including Helpful Content updates, Core Web Vitals, spam signal updates (e.g., SpamBrain), and the implications of generative AI on search
  • Proven experience collaborating with Paid Media, Dev, and Content teams though: meeting preparation, client-facing communications, running joint meetings,
  • Specialist in ecommerce SEO

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Looker Studio (Data Studio), Supermetrics, or other reporting tools
  • Familiarity with AI-driven tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Surfer, Peec AI, Profound AI, etc.
  • Familiarity with common CMS softwares; especially Wordpress with Woocommerce, Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce
  • Experience using Google Tag Manager for tracking setups, including event and key event configuration in GA4
  • Experience creating and managing custom reports and dashboards in GA4

Key Behaviors

  • Moldability / adaptability - Successful bloomers bring their diverse set of experience to the role, but use this to adopt and excel performing work “The Searchbloom way”. Successful candidates can take / give feedback to adapt & grow
  • “A Player” - We do not accept mediocrity, everyone in Searchbloom is expected to contribute to “unified excellence” / one experience. A key component of this is ‘player’ (i.e. employee must operate in and thrive as a team)
  • Attitude > Aptitude
  • “Core Values” - Candidates live and execute these values regularly
  • Transparency / Integrity - As a remote workforce we expect high-degrees of proactivity & self-management. Work must be completed on time, and according to standards. We expect not to have to manage ‘the basics’ (standards of professional conduct, etc)
  • 6 week ramp-up - Successful candidates must be able to manage accounts in a partner-facing capacity within six weeks
  • Strategic thinking - Candidates must be able to create, articulate, execute, & pivot strategic actions (roadmap). Doing so requires ability to be empathetic and understand true partner goals beyond just results

Responsibilities

  • Lead the SEO relationship for your assigned clients
  • Own SEO strategy for category, subcategory, and product detail pages, balancing crawl efficiency, rankings, and conversion support
  • Audit and optimize PDP and category templates for structured data, internal linking, indexation, and performance at scale
  • Lead client calls as the primary SEO voice, educate, recommend, and defend strategic direction
  • Perform advanced audits using a suite of SEO tools to surface technical and content opportunities
  • Write Point of View (POV) documents and recommendations based on partner needs and data
  • Prioritize initiatives by difficulty, cost, and potential impact, make budget recommendations
  • Partner with Paid Media and ecommerce teams on product feed optimization to improve organic shopping visibility
  • Collaborate with Paid Media, Content, and Development teams to execute multi-channel strategies
  • Execute SEO deliverables such as keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, competitive gap analysis, and technical improvements
  • Conduct QA on SEO deliverables produced by SEO peers
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to SKU sprawl, thin PDPs, duplicate categories, and parameter driven URLs
  • Monitor performance and iterate strategy based on analytics and client KPIs
  • Mentor junior SEO talent as needed and contribute to improving our internal SEO playbooks
  • Proactively surface new opportunities and test ideas that improve results (within above-mentioned frameworks of prioritization)
  • Use AI to scale audits, surface gaps, or assist with content ideation, while relying on human strategy for final decision-making

Key Performance Indicators

  • ROI for your partners
  • Partner retention
  • Organic traffic growth
  • SEO-driven conversion volume
  • Technical SEO health scores
  • Net Promoter Score

Why Choose Searchbloom?

Health & Financial:

  • Health/Vision/Dental Coverage – PPO or HSA plans available
  • $50,000 in life insurance paid by Searchbloom

Time Off:

  • 14 days of PTO in year one
  • 13 company holidays, including full week off for Christmas
  • Your birthday and work anniversary off

Work Environment:

  • 100% remote agency
  • Flexible work hours
  • Business casual dress code
  • Office Improvement Credit

Growth & Culture:

  • Searchbloom promotes almost exclusively from within
  • $50,000+ invested in annual Learning & Development across our team
  • Paid parental leave (maternity & paternity)
  • Employee Wellness Program (free Fitbit + fitness challenges)
  • Awarded Best Place to Work by Inc. (twice)

You’ll work with a passionate, driven team where we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality work that makes a real-world impact for our partners.

What Our Team Says
“The CEO is one of the best people I have ever met. He cares about every single employee and their success. Wicked smart as well.”
“Excellent opportunities to learn and grow. They won’t make you work with awful clients.”
“Fun and diverse partnerships, supportive team, great work-life balance.”

Guideway Care is The Patient Activation Company™. We don't just "engage" patients; we activate them. By utilizing our proprietary Motivational Patient Guidance (MPG) model and AI-powered technology, we resolve the practical and psychological barriers that prevent patients from taking their "next right action."™

Job Summary:

At Guideway Care, relationships matter. We're looking for a Senior Director of Business Development who already has trusted relationships with executive leaders across ACOs, CINs, IPAs, Medicare Advantage plans, and other risk-bearing healthcare organizations. This isn't a role focused on cold prospecting or transactional selling. It's an opportunity to leverage years of credibility, open strategic doors, and help expand a solution that delivers measurable financial and clinical outcomes.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop and execute a scalable go-to-market strategy focused on value-based care and risk-bearing organizations
  • Lead multiple complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting through close, including enterprise-level negotiation

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect sales strategy to broader company growth objectives
  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets in complex, consultative sales environments
  • Deep understanding of ACOs, health systems, and physician networks, with existing relationships across value-based or risk-bearing entities strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to lead complex sales cycles involving senior healthcare executives and key decision-makers
  • Strong negotiation skills and executive presence with the ability to communicate value at the C-suite level
  • Experience with healthcare technology, tech-enabled services, or patient engagement solutions preferred

Benefits package including:

  • Vision Insurance

  • Company paid short- and long-term disability,
  • Employee Assistance Program,
  • Life Insurance,
  • Accident insurance,
  • and other voluntary benefit programs for employees and their eligible dependents.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Able to work remotely at home in a private HIPAA compliant workspace

We applaud qualified applicants who are accountable and committed to producing quality work. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we support and value diversity, dignity, and respect in our work environment, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment in which everyone can thrive.

Position Summary:

The Analyst, Business and Competitive Intelligence is responsible for the identification, information gathering, planning and coordinating of sales based communication activities for a selection of designated accounts and contacts to effectively support business growth. Ultimately sourcing new sales opportunities for the Business Development team through inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting inclusive of Clinical Solutions, Labs and Biospecimens.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Periodically liaises directly with the Business Development team to identify specific companies of interest for continued nurtured outreach and meeting/RFP provision.
  • Analyzes competitive environment to help make recommendations.
  • Develops an annual outreach plan (reviewed monthly with LM and Business Development team) focused on securing new and repeat business from current and prospective biotech and pharmaceutical companies based on the analysis of:
    • Social media (business news review, financial news, new lead identification, …)
    • Competitive intelligence / business strategy (reviewing competitors website, conferences, communication/marketing activities)
    • Decision makers and influencers within the identified company
  • Undertakes research and analysis of Precision’s markets, competition, product mix, and specified product markets.
  • Works closely with the Marketing teams to coordinate appropriate collateral provision to support the sales efforts of the company.
  • Responsible for updating appropriate systems (Customer Relationship Management, Sales Enablement platforms etc) in a timely manner to ensure high standards of data integrity and for generating accurate weekly/monthly activity reports.
  • Provides regular feedback to the LM, and Business Development leadership on the positioning of the company regarding pricing, competitiveness and market conditions.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors degree in a marketing/communication/science or business related discipline/or equivalent experience in a marketing/communication/business development/sales environment.
  • Possesses a keen understanding of the CRO and Specialty Labs market and the role that Precision plays in that environment.
  • Minimum 6 months experience within the product/service sales lifecycle inclusive of client identification and prospecting.
  • Direct B2B sales experience in service industry.

Other Required:

  • Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel including overnight stays.
  • Reads, writes, speaks fluently and comprehends the English language.
  • Drive and determination to succeed as well as meet and exceed targets and quotas.
  • Must be adaptable, professional and motivated and understand the sales cycle.

Preferred:

  • Experience in either the CRO/pharmaceutical industry, or the life sciences industry.

Competencies:

  • Exhibits high self-motivation, and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Focuses on continuous improvement, including the ability to make proactive assessments on how to make processes more efficient and people more effective.
  • Communicates both verbally and in written form in an exemplary manner.
  • Conducts formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including scientific / sales / marketing teams.

raw.description:
As a Field Marketer, you will own regional field strategy and activation for Vena’s UK & EMEA business, translating regional market opportunity, Sales priorities and Vena’s global go-to-market strategy into integrated activations that generate and progress pipeline.
You will identify high-value audiences, segments and account concentrations, then determine and execute the right field marketing mix across Vena-led programs, partner-led activations, industry and community events, webinars and other targeted experiences. You will also extend Vena's corporate Marketing activations through the regional ecosystem, identifying opportunities to engage partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
As the connection between UK & EMEA and Vena's primarily North America-based Marketing organization, you will bring regional market intelligence into GTM planning and adapt global campaigns, content and programs where regional relevance requires it.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.
This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Manage UK & EMEA field marketing strategy and activation, translating regional market opportunity, target-account concentration, pipeline needs and Vena's GTM priorities into an integrated field marketing plan.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value segments, audiences and market opportunities using pipeline, account and market intelligence, then recommend the field marketing plays most likely to generate or progress demand.
  • Own the end-to-end execution of regional field programs, including Vena-led events, partner-led and co- in market activations, industry/community opportunities, webinars, and other targeted programs that drive results
  • Extend Vena's corporate event and campaign investments through the regional ecosystem, partnering with Vena's Events and Marketing teams to activate relevant partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Enablement, Ecosystem and broader Marketing organization to align to regional activation with target accounts, active pipeline and priority GTM plays.
  • Drive field activation from concept through conversion, including audience strategy, promotion, content requirements, vendors/logistics, attendee experience, lead capture, Sales follow-up and post-program nurture.
  • Measure success through qualified demand, pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact, establishing clear tracking, attribution and reporting requirements.
  • Translate global Vena campaigns, content and enablement into regional activation, identifying where localization or regional requirements are needed and bringing those requirements back to the appropriate Marketing or Enablement owner.
  • Build strong relationships with UK & EMEA partners and identify where partner expertise, audiences, and distribution can strengthen GTM programs and shared pipeline goals.
  • Act as the regional market intelligence loop, ensuring regional insights, buyer feedback, field learnings, competitive intelligence and program performance flow back into broader marketing planning.
  • Travel (as required) to events
  • Other duties, as assigned.

We'd Love to See

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, integrated demand generation or partner marketing, ideally within EPM SaaS or a high growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify regional or segment-level growth opportunities and translate them into integrated field marketing programs that generate and progress pipeline.
  • Experience owning programs end to end, from audience and segmentation strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, and measurement of pipeline impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in executing repeatable in person programs and events that deliver our brand experience, elevate buyer and customer engagement and deliver measurable results.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners, Customer Success, and senior regional leaders.
  • A hands-on, team-first approach and willingness to move between strategic planning and detailed execution based on what the business needs, along with comfort proactively bridging time zone and communication gaps across a globally dispersed team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create or localize compelling content and messaging for North American buyers and sales teams.
  • Commercial and data-driven mindset with experience using pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance data to prioritize activity and evaluate impact.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions concurrently.
  • Confidence engaging with external partners, customers, vendors, and senior stakeholders, including supporting executive-level and CFO/Finance audiences.
  • Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with HubSpot or similar marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms, including campaign and pipeline reporting.
  • Experience marketing within or alongside the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft partners, Marketplace or Microsoft-aligned GTM motions.
Base salary range 45,488-61,543 GBP

As you progress in your role, your compensation may adapt, offering flexibility for growth beyond initial levels. raw.excerpt: JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.  Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients.
raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

This position will lead strategic identity security initiatives across the company as well as delivering global Identity Provider (IdP) and privileged access management controls.  The role will provide knowledge, guidance, and ownership around both internal identity and CIAM matters across a range of on-premises, cloud-hosted, and third-party SaaS platforms.  The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing and executing best practices for secure management of identity and integrating multiple technologies.  We are looking for a highly collaborative technical engineer who can execute at both the strategic and tactical levels in a large, complex, and highly dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the engineering principal on implementing secure identity practices in technology architectures, including the enterprise IdP service used for global authentication.

  • Systematically modify and control identity security policy, standards and guidance to address use cases related users, on-premises services, cloud service providers, and SaaS

  • Collaborate closely with teams responsible for Active Directory and authentication services to enable compliance with security policy and standards

  • In partnership with the network security organization, lead the delivery of JLL’s zero trust strategy for users and third parties

  • Design privileged access management controls for all privileged accounts that minimize potential for abuse while enabling detection and response to insider and external cyber threats

  • Own, operate, and advance the JLL enterprise Privileged Access Management tool (CyberArk preferred)

  • Serve as SME for enabling the secure design of identity services, as well as delivering controls engineering to enforce account security policies and standards

  • Work with application development teams to implement best practices for CIAM in JLL’s online products

Qualifications:

As a Field Marketer, you will own regional field strategy and activation for Vena’s North American business, translating regional market opportunity, Sales priorities and Vena’s global go-to-market strategy into integrated activations that generate and progress pipeline.
You will identify high-value audiences, segments and account concentrations, then determine and execute the right field marketing mix across Vena-led programs, partner-led activations, industry and community events, webinars and other targeted experiences. You will also extend Vena's corporate Marketing activations through the regional ecosystem, identifying opportunities to engage partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
As the connection between Vena Marketing organization, you will bring regional market intelligence into GTM planning and adapt campaigns, content and programs to support regional activations.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Manage North American field marketing strategy and activation, translating regional market opportunity, target-account concentration, pipeline needs and Vena's GTM priorities into an integrated field marketing plan.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value segments, audiences and market opportunities using pipeline, account and market intelligence, then recommend the field marketing plays most likely to generate or progress demand.
  • Own the end-to-end execution of regional field programs, including Vena-led events, partner-led and co- in market activations, industry/community opportunities, webinars, and other targeted programs that drive results
  • Extend Vena's corporate event and campaign investments through the regional ecosystem, partnering with Vena's Events and Marketing teams to activate relevant partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Enablement, Ecosystem and broader Marketing organization to align to regional activation with target accounts, active pipeline and priority GTM plays.
  • Drive field activation from concept through conversion, including audience strategy, promotion, content requirements, vendors/logistics, attendee experience, lead capture, Sales follow-up and post-program nurture.
  • Measure success through qualified demand, pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact, establishing clear tracking, attribution and reporting requirements.
  • Translate Vena campaigns, content and enablement into regional activation, identifying where localization or regional requirements are needed and bringing those requirements back to the appropriate Marketing or Enablement owner.
  • Build strong relationships with North American partners and identify where partner expertise, audiences, and distribution can strengthen GTM programs and shared pipeline goals.
  • Act as the regional market intelligence loop, ensuring regional insights, buyer feedback, field learnings, competitive intelligence and program performance flow back into broader marketing planning.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

We'd Love to See

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, integrated demand generation or partner marketing, ideally within EPM SaaS or a high growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify regional or segment-level growth opportunities and translate them into integrated field marketing programs that generate and progress pipeline.
  • Experience owning programs end to end, from audience and segmentation strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, and measurement of pipeline impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in executing repeatable in person programs and events that deliver our brand experience, elevate buyer and customer engagement and deliver measurable results.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners, Customer Success, and senior regional leaders.
  • A hands-on, team-first approach and willingness to move between strategic planning and detailed execution based on what the business needs, along with comfort proactively bridging time zone and communication gaps across a globally dispersed team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create or localize compelling content and messaging for North American buyers and sales teams.
  • Commercial and data-driven mindset with experience using pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance data to prioritize activity and evaluate impact.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions concurrently.
  • Confidence engaging with external partners, customers, vendors, and senior stakeholders, including supporting executive-level and CFO/Finance audiences.
  • Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with HubSpot or similar marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms, including campaign and pipeline reporting.
  • Experience marketing within or alongside the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft partners, Marketplace or Microsoft-aligned GTM motions.
  • Travel (as required) to events

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

Home is more than a place—it is where much of life unfolds. We are seeking a contract writer and photographer to create a visually rich, inspiring book that explores the beauty, meaning, and everyday experiences of home through photography, storytelling, Scripture, and biblical reflection. This project should encourage readers to see God's grace and presence in the ordinary rhythms of life, offering hope and inspiration for a variety of life stages, family structures, and living situations. The strongest proposals will demonstrate a compelling visual vision and a thoughtful approach to integrating photography with encouraging, Christ-centered content.

Scope of Work

  • Conceptualize, photograph, and write a highly visual book (approximately 20,000–30,000 words)
  • Develop content that thoughtfully integrates photography, Scripture, personal reflection, storytelling, and biblical encouragement
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Work with the design and editorial teams to ensure strong integration between visual and written content

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.

Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “VP of Engineering” Role

Role and Team:

As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

Daily Work:

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

  • Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
  • Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
  • Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
  • Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

  • Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
  • Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
  • A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
  • Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
  • Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
  • Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock option package
  • Performance-based incentive compensation
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.
  • All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year
  • Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our company:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.

  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.
